Our government plans to combine the financial management lesson with the junior high school education. In my opinion, it is a good decision. Such a financial management lesson is very important for the young. Because more and more teenagers spend money without thinking twice. It is easy for them to get money from their parents, but they just don't know how to save it. They buy everything they want when they have money. Therefore, by the financial management lesson, teenagers can lear how to manage their own money.
Take me for example, I live out by myself now. But I don't have ability to work to earn money, my parents will give me some money every week. I can eat lunch at school, so I only have to spend money on breakfast and dinner every day, and it doesn't cost all money my parents give me. When I go home, I will save the money I don't use in a box. Week by week, I will find that there is much money I save in the box. That it the way how I can have own allowance.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In recently twenty years, our economic become better than before. Everyone has his or her own fortune, but most of them don't know how to deal with it. I suppose that the government make it a lesson in our education is a good measure, because it provides us more proffessinal news and ideas to manage our fortune.
Take me for instance, I don't follow any fashion trends or like any brand-name things. So, I put most of my allowance to my account. I just save my money into the bank, not knowing how to make it become more money. When seeing this news, I was agreeable! There is a great chance for me to take good use of money.
Most of all, the authorities concerned should take immediate measures to make it a good program.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial managemt lesson is not important to the junior high students. First, the parents won't give their children too much money at the junior high, so they even have no money to manage. Adults want to learn the financial management because they want to buy something expensive, like a car, a house, or something else. They learned it for making more money, but the junior high students probably not spend much time to care their money. This is my second point. Students can choose to learn the lesson, not be asked to learn it.
I always took some plans to manage my money, like now, I want to buy a camera by myself, so I began to find some jobs, when I got the paid, I put it all into the other wallet. The living cost and playing cost is seperated, and I wrote everything what I spent in the book that I can see clearly.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Ministry of Education made a decision to let "financial management" lesson enter education of junior high school. But, I have some questions that I ask for answers. First, backgrounds of these students are different. Do our teachers have the ability to find problems among those, hurting their hearts? Next, if they take the lessons, they may appear a terrible thought: I have only a little money; but one day I will become a millionaire or a billionaire without any work. "No pains, no gains" will break out.
To myself, I usually make a good use. The rest will be saved. Never waste any cent you could use. To make a conclusion, what is the importance of financial management lessons?

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial management course is quite important. Generally speaking, a person who can make good financial management will probably earn more money than the one who cannot.
In my opinion, there are many ways to do some financial managements. To take an example, easily, saving money in a bank is one of the ways. It is quite easy and the risk is small. Also, it is slower to earn money.
Another example, you can do some inventions. Although it is more complicate and the risk is much bigger, you can earn more money quicklier.
I usually save my salary, because I don't know how to invent. So I support this plan. I think utilizing the class to teach students some common sense of financial management and how to "temporatly" invent would help them know how to take charge their money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I have never thought before that financial management will be put in junior education. As far as I am concerned, there may be some pros and cons in this program.
I always set aside my allowance. But for those who use money without restriction, it is crucial to instill the ideal of economical to them. Still, this project may be too profund to a junior high to comprehend, and this is the disadvantage. My individual thought is that we can teach them in a simple way such as to tell a story, show comics to them, or tell daily events including the conception of economical, and so on. Such being the case, they can easily learn the lesson without any burdan.
At the end of the day, no matter how austere things students have to tackle, they'd make it through if they do things step by step.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think put the financial management course into the education is hugely important to students who really need this financial concept. Due to present-day student have no concept about money management so that they often waste too much money on something they don't really need. So the proposal is vital for most of them.
Take me for example, when I get pocket money from my parents, I often store it to a bank because I know how hard my parents earn money and I have a plan that the money my parents had given me for many years can be used when I go to university so that I can alleviate my parents' burden. To conclude, I think the financial management course will play an essential role in the life of students.

subject: IW-0962
content: Financial management is important? or not? For my viewpoint, I think it is very important in our life. When you are shopping in a convenience store or a department store, you could buy a lot of products. However, after you considering carefully, are those which you bought necessary? I think not. Most of them could be used only two times even one time in a year. For those shoppers, these products could waste lots of their money. I think everybody should learn financial management. In this way, they couldn't spend much their money on what is not necessary. Take my experience for example, I usually use my pocket money in plan. When I want to buy something, I would make a list to know what I need. So, I wouldn't spend a lot on unnecessary things. Financial management is an important lesson for everyone to learn.

subject: IW-0962
content:
About the goverment want to add the financial magagement in the junior high school lessons. I think it is not very appropriate. In daily life, I can use my poket money in the right way. When I got the money from my parents, I usually saved it. Sometimes I want to buy new clothes or something I extremely wanted. I will use my money to buy. As the time I really need to use money in neccessary, I also can do it myself. These behavior above is learning by myself in life without being taught in class. For this reason, I think the financial magagement lesson is not very important and neccessary to the junior high students. They can learn the simple tips to manage their money in daily life. The financial mangement might too difficult for junior high students to learn. Most important of all, it might gave them so much study pressure. All of them will have no time to relax and take a rest. In my opinion, I don't agree the plan that decide to put financial management in the school lessons. It is so early to learn and students might not absorb the knowledge about it very well. It just make students have no time to do other things.
Having a happy life instead of busy life is more important for students.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think it is important to put the financial management into the junior high school lessons. As far as I am concerned, I think teaching those students in junior high how to make good use of their money is workable. Because they are too young to manage their money. Take my younger sister for instance, I always find her having new things or clothes I've never seen before. Then, I know she must go shopping and buy what she sees and desires not what she needs. To sum up, I think it's correct to put the financial management into junior lessons. Talk with my pocket money. I am a student living outside in the dorm, so I have to manage my pocket money carefully. Except for buying three meals, I almost don't use my money. But if there is something I really need immediately, I will luse my money. Not wasting money as my younger sister, I am a person who use my pocket money usefully.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the financial management classes are very important. Because if I spent too much money than I earned, I would become a poor man. Many students don't know what is financial management, they just know they have much money and they can buy many things which they may not need. If they can know financial management, they would know what things are important and what they don't buy.
My parents opened a store to earn money when I was in elementary school, I helped my parents that time. I know it is very hard to earn money, so I always think twice before I spend money. My parents give me fifty dollars before I go to school because they think if I were hungry at school, I could buy some snacks. Instead, I didn't buy anything. I saved money to avoid if I need it one day.

subject: IW-0962
content: Financial management is essential for everyone to learn. It helps us know how to make a plan for our money. If junior high students learn it, the students will benefit from it. Managing money is good for not only everyone but also the economy. Making good use of money is the most important thing for future. If the students have the knowledge about it, their parents won't be worried about their children's future. In contrast, if the students don't know how to deal with financial problems, they may waste money. For example, I use my pocket money to buy the things I really need, and I store the rest money to help my parents go through the money difficulties. Preparing more in advance is not harmful for everyone. Therefore, I consider the goverment should have the jonior high students learn it. It is a good way to help our country and everyone. After all, Taiwan is a commercial country.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I think the financial management is most important, so it should be added to junior high school course.
Because, nowdays teenagers have no right knowledge of financial, they alway waste much money, cost money like using water.
Therefore, the financial management course is necessary for everyone. Through it, teenagers or others will have a good financial management, ours economic will rapid up.

subject: IW-0962
content: To tell the truth, I think that financial management classes are relly important for junior high school students, because spending has a big part in our life in the future. If we don't give opinions about financial management for teenagers, it may have troubles in spending money. To take an example for me, I have nine hundred dollars for a week. First, I will take three hundred dollars putting into my case. Also, I have remaining money to buy things that I want, and I don't have to take money from my parents. Because of this, we can find that contraling spending is really important for us. And finally, don't waste your money on useless things, or you can't afford it.

subject: IW-0962
content:
When the economy of Taiwan becomes worser and worser, financial management is really an important lesson to everyone. If someone would like to keep a habit of using his or her money meaningfully, he or she can be taught when they were young. In this way, not only can they save money easily but they can also teach this good habit to their children or someone they know.
Because I am still young and I don't have a job to earn money to support me, I regard the allowence that my parents give me as a treasure. When my parents give me allowence, I usually save it so that I can have enough money to buy something I need someday. It's also important that the thing you buy is what you want or what you need.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think that the financial management is very important. Because it becomes more and more people that do not know how to manage their money and how to use their money well. For example, many young people like to use the credit cards, but they don't judge their money, just buy what they want. In the end, they usually could not pay back for the bank. So, I think it necessary for the teenagers to know how to manage their money well.
I don't think that my financial management is doing well, but I am used to writing down what I spent every day. And I keep half of my pocket money that my parents give me every month. If it not very necessary, I never take those money to use.

subject: IW-0962
content:
It goes without saying that financial management is an important skill in our lifes. I think it is neccessary to put it into a subject in junior high school. Because if you didn't know how to manage your money correctly, you may end up become very poor. Financial management class might help us using our money in a better way, not always waste it. So I think it is very important to get it into a subject.
My mom gives me pocket money by weeks. I won't buy things that I won't use. Every week I can save some money, as time goes by, I will have a great deal of money. So I can use it in the way I want and won't worry about whether my money was enough or not.

subject: IW-0962
content:
When I am in school, I always wonder why many students can spend so much money. They waste money to buy new clothes, comic books, junk food and so on. So I think the financial management is important for all of us. It can help teenagers form a habit of managing their money well. After all, our pocket money is from our parents' hard work. We shouldn't waste it on what we don't really need.
Every month, I can receive one hundred dollars as my pocket money from my mother. Though I want to buy many things, I always choose indispensable ones and buy them. Think it twice if I really need them. Then, other left money will be put in my bank account. My mom always tells me "As you sow, so you will reap. If you want to make fortune and help other people, you shouldn't waste any cent."

subject: IW-0962
content:
It goes without saying that everyone want more money to use. But how can we use money in more ways when we are earning the same income? It is important for people to be educated to save money and use it wisely. With the class we can live a easy life.
Junior high schools is going to teach their students about financial management. I am very happy to hear about it. In my family, I am the only one child. Dad and Mom always buy me anything I want. But now, as I am growing up, I gradually know that money should be wisely used and I am learning to use money. I hope one day I will take the financial management class and then become a meney wise user.

subject: IW-0962
content: Hearing that the government is planning to make the ability of finacial management to become senior high school students' skill, I am very surprised. Though some people may not agree this plan because they think it is too early that children couldn't realize what they will learn, I still think it as an important step to our lives. When a child realize how to handle with the money he has, he may not waste it. And with the years go by, he turn into an adult who can manage his life. I, for example, learned about how to make the most use of my pocket money since I was a little girl. At the time I was a child, I did not like other classmates who spent their money to candies. I saved the money. Now, as I become an adult, I also save the money in the bank. I think, the earlier people learn about finacial management, the less people will go bankrupt and choose to end their lives. So, it is important to make children learn how to handle with their pocket money.

subject: IW-0962
content: Education is more and more important for people who lives in Taiwan. Now, the goverments plan to put financial management into the education of junior high school. I think it is not only important but necessary to do this plan, because many teenagers spent a lot of money to buy something which is not necessary and without telling their parents. This situation also can be found in some rich people, and finally they become more and more poorer. So, how to use our money effectively is important. For example, I usually put my money in the bank and don't use money causally. And not to buy something you don't need, including comic books, novels and even video games. If you can do all of things I tell you, you would be happy everyday. And you won't worry about why your money is always not enough to buy things.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I think financial management course is very essential. Because most of people have not this kind of conception. They don't know how to save money and alway complain they don't have money. Financial management is important that can teach us how to cut off the money and we also learn how to plan your money in proper when you retire. We don't worried how could I become in the rest of life or count on my children take care of me.
When I get salary, I seperate it two section. One of salary is my allowance, I can use it to buy what I need. The rest of salary is depposite in the post office. In that way, I not only save a lot of money but also spent in proper.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Educational Department will plan to gain the financial management program into the junior high school education. In my opinion, it is important for students to join the class. Why? Nowadays, there are more and more students have their money, but they don't know how to govern their money. Consequently, I think that students have to join the financial management.
First of all, I have some ways to govern my money. In case that I have the salary, I take three thousand to my parents, because I think that the parents raise up me, so I have the responsibility to give them some money. Then, I spend four thousand on clothes, and shopping will help me to reduce my pressure in my work. And finally, I deposit salary in the bank.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The department of education plans to put the financial management course into the junior education course is not only useful but also important. Nowaday, many teenagers do not know how to use their money. If they have money they will spend it as soon as they can. Therefore, teachers have to teach them how to manage their finance and let them know how hard their parents are to earn money for them using.
As me, when I was in junior high school, my mother has already teached me how to manage my finance. At most time, I only spend a quater of my money, others will be saved. I think save money is more interested than spend money. Don't you think so?

subject: IW-0962
content:
With the rapid technology, more and more people can take advantage of their knowledge to make them rich. Nevertheless, there are some people still in proverty. The one reason of all may be that they can use their money in a right way, so, I think that financial management will be an essential class in junior high school.
In order to cultivate we children the good habit of dealing with our money. Many parents may encourage their children to put their pocket money in the post office or buy books that are good for them to read. I did the same thing when I was a junior high school student. But, with my age increasing, I'm no more than a kid; instead, I am a senior high school student who can learn how to use money. So, my mother always let me to do or buy what I need or want except something bad. For instance, I always buy some books like encyclopedia to enrich my knowledge, and sometimes use it to go movies with friend.
You may feel strang that whether I have extra money to keep in post office. I will say "Yes I do.", because I will be gived some money for my good score in school. And, I will use these money to pay what I need to pay in school. Because of these good habits, I never worried about things about money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management will be a lesson of junior high school. Some people think it is important, and I think it is, too. Because many people do not know how to do a good financial management. They often spend their money on many unimportant things. If they do not correct their habit, they will become poor in the future. It is too bad!
I usually spend my money on some things, such as books and dictionaries. I think they are good for me and I can learn more knowledge. If I have a little money afterward, I will not spend them and bring them to the bank. If I have no money in the future, I can use them. This is a good way to save money, isn't it?

subject: IW-0962
content: In my opinion, I think that goverment should put the subject of financial management in junior-high education. Seven of ten students now, like to dress themself in a fashion way. Nomatter how expensive the cloth is, just show the credit card and pack it home. That's really a waste of money, to students. I've gotten in the habbit of saving money since I entered elementary school. My parents gave me 50 dollars every weeks. Except buying pens or books, I always saved 30 dollars a week. Now, I also tell myself that I have to save at least a half of money I get a week. "Though you just save a little money a week; in the end, you will get a big fortune." To that time, you can use the forture to buy whatever you like, and even in a good mood when you spending it.

subject: IW-0962
content: In this society, you will find that more and more students do not manage their finance properly because their parents always help them do anything and tell them all they need to do is just focus on their studies, teenages almost have no abilitis to deal with problems of finance. Now, the Education Bureau plans to take the course of financial management into education of the junior high school. In my opinion, it's an excellent idea to improve contemporary teenages' lack of the abilities to understand how the financial systems work. The course can give students a new concept which can make them not see the money just as something to use on buying. On the other hand, I think I use my allowance appropriately. Instead of spending all of my allowance on what I desire. I deposit them into the bank, which I can depand on to the fullest.

subject: IW-0962
content:
When it comes to the issue, I do think that it is very important to cultivate a correct concept of financial management, which would lead us to the right way of spending money.
People said that "Learning is like sailing a boat against the current, it either advances or retreats." We should learn the things around us. My mother always tells me that money is not everything, but it plays an important role in our daily life. So we shouldn't waste it. My mother doesn't give me any money.
If I were fortunate enough to spend money of my choice, I would bought books which I am interesting in But in truth, I don't have any money!

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is very important to teach financial management when we are in junior high school. Because people tend to spent money everyday. For instance, Mothers spend money on daily meals, and teanagers spend money on their new clothes. There's no denying that learning finacial management may help us understand more about how to spend money and manage our expense well.
I also take action in my daily life. For example, if I some pocket money. However, I really need a new pencil since the old one had broken. Then, I'll spend maybe twenty dollar on the new pencil and save rest of them.
It is really important to save money since we spend it evey day in my life. So I think it's good to teach this kind of lesson.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Financial management. To tell the truth, it had already been a course in many universities. So why not it also been a course in junior high school. In my opinions, the only one difference between the two was deepth and field. To take an example, financial management courses in universities could talk about how to investigate, but it was not appropriate for junior high school students.
If we could been educated about financial management early, and there were not more and more humen in the bad financial circulation. And we could not repeat these had habbits by educated.
As far as I was concerned, I would make my money well distribution. The first thing I did after I got money was to make it to some parts. For example, some I had to save for the furture emergency using, and some for foods and gasoline, and the others for entertainment. And their propotion may be 3:5:2. For this management, it would not make myself get into bad financial situation.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I think that this financial management will be an important part in our life. In morden society, every one should learn to how to plan my limit money, and how to use limit money efficiently. In other word, If we would'n use our money efficiently. We will maybe be the poor someday. Oh! It's a very terrible thing. Because of this I think this class is very important for us. This class can not only teach us how to use and spend our money but also can make me become the poor into the rich.
When it comes to my allowance or salary. I always use it in our acdemic books, because I am a student. I don't need a lot of money in my life every day, So I always put my allowance into the bank. I think that I should prepare money for our future when I meet something problems or need money of a sudden, then I will use it.

subject: IW-0962
content: Nowadays, financial management has become more and more important; especially when the economic recession struck the world, people thought that they can't overemphasize the importance of it. In my personal opinion, I think it is better to acquaint students with how to deal with their money. To do so can help them solve economical problems when confronted with them in the future. Take myself for example, I have had three hundred dollars per week as my allowance since junior high. I seldom spent my money on useless things. In other words, not until I were really in need did I spent my money. And I knew that one day I would become rich because of my daily hardship. So, I think it is very important for everyone to learn how to manage their own money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I am strongly in favor of the project. For one reason, it can help students manage their accounts wisely and efficiently without spending more money than needed. For example, some students often buy too many comic books instead of their meals. For another students can learn the importance of saving money for the future. So, I think the adoption of financial management curriculm for junior high school students will help a lot.
When I get my monthly salary, I always divide it into three parts -- for saving, for emergency and for the cost of living. Because I consider that this way can make me spend on the right things, and it really does. By so doing, my life is so cozy and comfortable.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opinion, I think that the financial management is very important. Because too many people can't manage their money well, they become the slaves of money. I think that if they can learn more about how to manage their own money, they may not become the slaves of money. Also, many children spend too much money to get everythings they want, but not they really need. If they could learn how to use their money in a right way, they might not be too waste.
I usually separate my money in two parts. One of them is saving in the post office. It can be used when I need money emergentally. The other is keeping with me, and I spend it when I buy some pens, notebooks, and coats. I think that financial management is very important, because of it, we can learn how to manage our money and spend our money well. Through of it, we will have less chance to become the slaves of money.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think that it is important to learn financial management. Everyone needs to use money. If they can't use limit money well, they may steal others things to satisfy his need. They will become trouble maker. Or become bombs of the society, it's very dangerous.
I deal with my allowance in some ways. First, I store 30% of it in the bank, in order to prevent some times I need large amount of money.
Second, I write a list what I have to buy. I follow the list to buy nessary things.
Third, if there still have few money, I will buy some cookies or sweet as a present that I use my money well.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the class of financial management is very important for every one, especially for young people.
When I was young, I bought everything without think about prices, because I think money is not a very important thing, and if I had no money, all I need to do is to ask my parents to give me money. After I went to university, my parents give me 6000 NT dollors per month, and told me they won't give me more money if I spend out all of my allowance, because they wanted me to learn how to use money meaningful and understand making money is not easily. In the beginning I was hard to suit for that, but now I know that is very terrible if you didn't know how to control use money. So, I think the class of financial management is good for every one.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is essential to every student. It make young people know how to make good use of allowance. There are a lot of temptation full of the society. They connot resist to pay money without think again and again. Sometimes, they bought something they don't in need. The lesson can make them realize how to use their allowance and save money for a rain day.
I always use my allowance to buy something ineed cost, such as food, and so on.

subject: IW-0962
content:
The education department made such a class about financial management was really good to students. Although the class may not be as important as such classes like Science or Society on exam, but it is difinetly what students should learn and know how to use. Beside the class, there were many students who do not actually know how to use their money. Maybe they would make the full use of their money but didn't know where did they use their money. There are many people crying on the TV about unabling to pay the bill of their credit cards. If the students don't learn how to use their money, they will become such people in the end.
In my opinion, I got NT 3000 dollars a month. I would take NT 1800 dollars as eating cost and NT 500 dollars as buying what I want, like CDs, novels or comic books. The last NT 100 dollars I wouldn't make use of them. Because I am afraid of someday I need some money but I do not have any. I think everyone has to think of ideas about how to use their money, because everyone has their suitable way.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think take the financial management into the junior high school education is important. Because managing our pocketmoney in the right way is a necessary lesson in our life. Most of the junior high students start to get more money from their parents. If they were poor of spending money, the situation would be bad in the final. Like borrowing money from classmate or even stoling money from their parents to satisfy what they want to buy with money.
I usually take my pocketmoney in several parts. Half of them will be regarded as daily needs, such as food or drink. Three tenths of them will be spent on the clothes, and the other will be saved. Having the money left is the big lesson on financial management.

subject: IW-0962
content: Is the "financial management" class really impartant for junior high school education? I don't think so. I know that it's better to start to learn to manage money earlier, but we don't need to have such class in school. In Taiwan, most parents give their children some allowance. Thus, their children have the chance to use money. By the action of spending their money, students will learn the "financial management" well. Take myself as an example. When I was nine years old, my parents start to give me one thousand dollars every month. First time I got it, I spent all of it in one week. But when I was eleven years old, I still have about one hundred in my pocket at the time I got another one thousand. And now, I am sixteen years old, I use three hundred for drinks, two hundred for computer games, four hundred for clothes, and I can still save one hundred. Once having the experience of using money, every one can be a master of "financial management", so the "financial management" class isn't very important, the really necessary thing is to have the experience of using money.

subject: IW-0962
content: Now in Taiwan, the education department are going to put the financial management as a subject in junior high school. I think it's a right decision. Why? By doing so, we can teach them how to use money in the right way not just buying useless things. Because I study in fashion design, I have to spend a lot of money on buying things for making clothes. That why my parent will give me more money a month. I used to save a half money that help me not to cost too much in a day. Teaching student how to use their money when they are in junior high is very important. Or they will spend all the money they have in a short time.

subject: IW-0962
content: I consider that it is important to take subject financial management in junior high. Nowadays, parents usually give their children enough pocket money to spend on what the children want to buy. It makes children have no idea how to use their money carefully and save it. If the junior high school can give students some knowledge about financial management and tell them the importance of money, it will help a lot.
I'm a senior high school now. Since I almost go to cram school every day, I have five thousand dollars for a month. But I started to work when I was in the junior high school. Though the money which I make is not much, it's enough for me to buy clothes or books which I want. I usually give the money to people in need of help. When I helped someone with my own money, I have a lot of sense of achievement in my mind. It's the most wonderful thing for me!

subject: IW-0962
content:
What a new plan! I think it is necessary for students in junior high school. Most students don't know how to manage their finance. Therefore, they tend to spend much money when they see their favorite. They will spend their all allowance to buy what they want. Because they don't know how to save and make a budget.
I will write down what I bought and how much money I spent to remind me If I see my favorite, I won't buy them immediately, instead, I will consider if it is necessary or important for me. Then I decide to buy.
I think this plan will be useful for many students. As a result, they will learn how to save money and won't spend much money. How useful it is!

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my viewpoint, I think it's extremely important to add this new course to education of junior high school. First, there are more and more students having no idea about how to cope with their own money. In this way, many students would spend most of their money on some dispensable things. Second, if these younsters grow up, they will face many dangerous situations such as bankrupt.
As far as I'm concerned, I have two tips to deal with my allowance. First, if my mom give me twenty dollars, I'll store five dollars. It seems that five dollars are just little money. However, just a month later, I'll accumulate a fortune and then I can buy something I'm eager for. Second, some time I would ask my mom of relatively more money. By doing so, I can make a full plan for my money. To sum up, only through a good concept of financial management can I take advantage of my money to the fullest.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is essential for junior high school students to learn financial management. Because it is important to know how to manage their own money, and it's the earlier, the better.

I usually put my money into a box, and when I want to buy something, I won't directly take the money in that box, instead, I will think whether the stuff is essential first, if it is, then I will take the money.

subject: IW-0962
content: I think it is important to take the financial management into the junior high school's education. Many high school students don't plan how to use their money. Before you want to buy a thing that you want, you should think about is it useful or not. After all, it can't be too early to plan how you use your money in the right way.

subject: IW-0962
content:
Adding the course of financial management into the education of junior high schools, I think it is very important in my point of view. To myself, I usually save my money, and use it in a essential way, and I don't waste it anymore. As you take good use of your money, you will find that your money is more than which you need. Save your money to use it well!

content:

And they would forget how they can live with their friends happily because they only care about their money.
When it comes to my money, I don't care about how many I had cost. Because I don't like those people who spend all their money in the end of every mouth. I would like to save my money everyday because I believe that I save ten NT dollar per day, I will have many money when I become old like my grandmother. And I believe my life will become more and more happy.

content: It goes without saying that manage our money is important, but is it proper to put financial management as a class for junior high school student? I agree with it! I thing it's really a good plan to teach them how to save money and list budget, and tell them the benefit of it. As myself for an example, I save money since I was an elementary school student, my parants always encourage me to save it in the bank and list out the things I will spend in a week. When I save to three thousand dollars, I will commit them to save into my account because they will give me extra two thousand. Thanks to the conception they gave to me, I can go abroad by my own power next summer. subject: IW-0962
content:
The education system of junior high school in Taiwan is planned to be included financial management classes. In my opinion, financial management classes are really important. Most junior high school students in Taiwan are not good at managing their money. They may want to buy a lot of things they like. But most of them don't know how to use their money well. So, I think financial management classes are important to junior high school students.
When I was a junior high school student, I had the same problem as well. I would like to buy everything I like, but I didn't have a lot of money. At that time, I often used up my money in a short time. It was because that I didn't know how to manage my money. I didn't learn about that until my father taught me. If I had learned about it, I could have saved a lot of money. So, I think financial management classes are really important to junior high school students. It is necessary.

subject: IW-0962
content:
In my opint, how to deal with my money is more important than any others.
"Financial management" is an essential subject for human to realize. Because, in this modern world, money becomes more importent that before. We have to use it buy anything what We want beside health and life. Take my family for example, our computer is too old to use, but we are not vice at all, and we have to go school! How can we do? We just use it untill it doesn't work! The computer is too old, but we don't buy the new one. Why? Because it can still work although it is old. My mother will give me money everyday, and I will take those money in my wallet. I won't buy anything that I don't use it! Because I know my parent is working hard to earn!
Earning money isn't an easy thing for human. So It is necessary for children to learn "Financial management". We shouldn't buy things because of our desire! How to deal with your money? Just think twice when you buying!

Last but not least, it is in the aid of making me feel the most content, and I never complain that my money is tight!

subject: IW-0962
content:

In conclusion, financial management not only helps us use money skillfully, but also maks a reasonable life to us!

I agree with this decision because I think it's crucial to let adolescent know how to use their allowance. If nobody teaches them, then they might spend the money whenever they feel like buying something. They won't even try to save money.
Take me for instance. When I first had my allowance, I thought I could buy anything I like. So I kept spending money until one day my mom asked me how much money did I save. Mom was really angry to know that I spend all the money because she thought I was mature enough to control myself. I learned a lesson at that day.
Now when I get allowance from my mom, I feel appreciate. Without my mom's hard work, I couldn't get these money. I have learned how to resist the temptation of buying things desirable but useless and use the money appropiately.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think it is important to teach students financial management because everyone should know how to manage their money. If a man doesn't know how to manage his money, he'll become poor someday, and he won't be able to provide himself and his family a basic living.
When I get money, I always saves most of it. If I want to buy books or something I really need, I'll use my own money. Instead of buying snacks and drink outside, I always use my own bottle to drink water. It can not only save money but also protect the environment. Now I have enough money to buy something I want, not like some students who always ask their parents for money to buy things.
So I really think that we should teach students financial management. It's not just for now, and it's also for our future.

subject: IW-0962
content: There was a news saying the financial management would become one of the junior high school lessons. When I saw the news, I was a little bit surprised and confused. I thought that this kind of knowledge is very important to everyone for sure, but if we let it become an official lesson in junior high, teach the student and give them some tests, it might just brings more and more school pressure to the students, it wouldn't get better. We can tell the students that they can read books about it when the classes are out if they are interested in it. Or teach them to keep their money, not to spend it on something unuseful, I think this way will be better than just teaching and testing them all day.

subject: IW-0962
content:
I think the goverment let "Financial Management" into the junior education is such a good idea, but in the students side, it seems not so good.
Although financial management is an important lesson now, the students in Taiwan have no time to learn it. They have already have no time to rest and have no time to pay attention at school if they put this in school lesson, maybe the students will be very nervous and angry. But in most opinion, this can be a very confused.
If we don't have to learn financial management, we might be very confused with the way to use money or save money; but if we have to learn financial management, how we learn it?
For me, I have my own way to use my money, sometimes I will save it or give it to my mother; but usually I just use it to buy everything I want to eat. Maybe this is not a very good way to use money, but it just me! So many teachers and parents just don't like our way, so they think put financial management in the school lesson is a good idea. But they don't know the most important thing, "Do we really need this?", I think put "Financial Management" in the school lesson or not, needs more time to discuss.

subject: IW-0962
content:

When I grow up, I will well-organize the money that I have.

subject: IW-0962
content:

However, some people simply don't have plans on both using and saving their money, as a result, faces tragedy. The unawareness of financial problems even gave rise to a kind of people called "Shopaholic."
In short, adding financial management courses to junior high educations is an importent and highly agreeable action to me.

subject: IW-0962
content: The financial management is going to be one of the junior high school's subjects. content: I think it's not very important that let junior high school students learn the financial management class. They don't need to learn this subject. Because they are not able to earn money. content:

content:

subject: IW-0962
content:

subject: IW-0962
content:

Without enough knowledge of it, your assets can't be invested to a profitable place, then you can't call it "investing", especially in this era, which money can almost let everything happen.
I use and manage my allowance very carefully. That said, I haven't had the acess to investing my own money into the stock markent or bank, I'm not old enough to do so. Instead, I save most of my monthly allowance in my wallet, and tried my best not to pay attention to the products I love at roadside stands or even on website, so that I won't spend my money except for the necessities. Therefore, I can save nearly five hundrend dollars every month. It's actually almost one fifth as my allowance! Spend your money only when you need to, not want to. It's a simple rule, but it does wonders to me! Try it!

subject: IW-0962
content:

subject: IW-0962
content:

The Education Department plans to put financial management courses into the education of junior high. I think it is good. I consider that every one of us - even a child - must learn to manage his money properly. It's necessary to set a good habit of spending money from the early age.
Take me for example, my teacher of elementary school told us not to spend all of our money at the same time and try to deposit the rest of it every two or three weeks. She also taught us to record how much money we spent every day, and try to avoid the cost which is unrequired. I have done everything my teacher said since that time. subject: IW-0962
content:

More important for me, I would write down how much I spend one day in my note book. It can let me know how much I spend in a month. This is my financial manggement.

subject: IW-0962
content:

They spend money without a budget, purchasing high-priced products, which ends up loaning money from the banks and paying for the credit card bill by all the salary unlimitedly, even soaking into such vicious circle for good. Hence, financial management is obviously important.
However, how to be a successful financial manager? Take myself for instance, whenever my mother gave me the pocket money for a month, I will first seperate a month into four weeks. Second, I will save a quarter of my money in the bank. Last but not least, I approximately distribute the money to four weeks. As a result, I can not only use the saved money to buy the things I need but also get sufficient money to go through a wonderful month.
