There are several reasons that I consider her as my idol. First of all, she is alway the best student at school, and the lovely daughter at home. She tries to obey parents' wishes and make them feel happy all the time. Besides, she is willing to help me with my homework if I couldn't finish it by my own. As to me, Hui-Zhen is the smartest person in the world. Whatever I ask her, she could answer for me right away. Moreover, the help she gives me is not only in my learning, but also in my mind. When I feel depressed or confused, I always perfer to talk to her rather than others. Because I believe she is the only one who know me best and who could give me some great advises. Accordingly, my sister, Hui-Zhen, is the person that I admire most so far in my life.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have idols that they like, they sometimes will be movie stars, basketball players or famous writers, but now my idol is my mom.
My mom is a kind and gentle woman. First, She always can solve my problems. When I have some questions in geography, she will tell me the right answers fast and quickly. Second, she can cooperate with me when I study. I may read the articles loudly at home, she never stops me, also she will turn off the television then I will have a nice studying environment. Third, she can help me do lots of things when I am busy or tired. Once, while I was preparing the final exam in my bedroom, she washed dishes for me to ease my work.
People have their own idol, they will try to do something for him or her. Therefore, I will try to let my mom be happy, and she can love and help me forever!

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Tom De longe, the vocal and guitarist of former punk rock band "Blink 182." He is a guy that always do silly things and something people never understand it But he always make himself happy, no matter how the other people look at him. He makes great music, too! His music can catch young people's heart easily.
I'd like to be a happy guy like him, without thinking too much and been bothered by something which might make you sad. I want to be a great guitarist, too! So he is the idol of me, someone I can learn lots from him.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has an super idol in their mind. It can be celebrity, basketball player or movie star, even can be your family or one of your friends. They always have an influence on our life and our thought.
The super idol in my mind is Jolin, who is a well-known singer in Taiwan. She is characterized by her big eyes, beautiful face and good voice. In addition, she dances pretty well. And above all, she is very diligent and make all her effort into her job. On the other hand, she always chasing the best and achieving her goal. Moreover, she is so independent that she can do everything by herself. This is the character that I never have.
Jolin is such an attractive star that most of the teenagers are attracted by her, including me. She always takes an oppimistic view on everything, smiling to everyone she meets. Aside from those reason, the most important thing is that she is very wisdom and has the perfect life. That's why I like her so much. I am learning from her and expecting to have the same great spot as hers.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is not a movie star or a baseball player; my idol is my mom. She is the person who always accompanies with me and gives me advices no matter when or where I need her. For me, she is not only a successful woman in her career but also a kind mother in our family. When I was an elementary school student, she established a small cloth company. Although she is busy, every time I encounter obstacles; she stops her work and helps me. She always told me that earning money is important, but family is always be the first. I has grown up little by little, and gradually realize that she is a great woman who feeds up her children by herself and has a career of her own. My mom is my idol, I will always catch her steps and one day I can be a respected woman like her.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I have a lot of dreams, and one of those is to become my idol oneday. My idol wasn't a famous person, and even few people know her. Well, who is my idol? She is my classmate Amada. Why is she? She is smart, beautiful and thoughtful.
Let me introduce her to you. First, she is smart. She alaways gets good grades, even the test is really difficult. I think no problem can let her give up. I like to ask her questions, and she will answer me by a few minutes. She isn't just good at doing schoolwork. She is an illusionist. She can perform a lot of magic. Everybody likes her performance.
Second, she is beautiful. Her skin is as white as snow. She has long curly brown hair. She is like a model. She knows how to wear clothes to make her more beautiful. Not only outside but also inside, the heart, is beautiful. She is kind of everyone, even those nobody likes them.
Finally, she is thoughtful. There is no doubting that she alaways can make you happy. Everytime I don't feel good, she will come and ask me if I am all right. Telling her your problems is a good idea. She will do her best to help you.
I think that you really want to meet her, don't you? Don't worry about that. Next time you meet a girl who has a big smile on her face maybe she is her. I know you will like her at first sight.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is my math teacher, Mr. Lin. He is not only a good teacher but also a talented singer. He always tells us to study math happily and easily instead of staying up late doing homework in the night. He is so amused that we are never bored in his class. Besides, Mr. Lin likes to sing songs with us in class. He has a great musical talent, so he could play three musical instruments at the age of eighteen. Of course, his voice is pretty good, too. Therefore, he is popular among all the students. And Mr. Lin is also said to be the best and the most popular "Singer Teacher" in school!

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their favorite idols. Most of them like famous singers or actors. However, my idol is neither very handsome nor well-known in Taiwan. He is Jeff Hardy.
Jeff Hardy is in the World Wrestling Entertainment. One of my friends who also likes to watch wrestling told me he is very popular. Many of the audience like him a lot. I always cheer for him in front of my television at home. Everytime I watch him on TV, I feel so excited. This is one of the reason why I like him.
He always improves his skills everytime, and he often gives some surprises to his fans. He is really cool. Also, he never gives up easily in the matches. This is the way how he respects his enemies. He sometimes gets hurt badly, and his doctor doesn't let him appear for a few months. His fans always give him supports, and he always tries to get back to the ring as soon as he can. I think he is very hard-working, and he always does his best. This is my idol, Jeff Hardy.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Most people have an idol in their own life. Take me for example, I also have one. My idol is a man who lives in the same house and has the same parents with me. He is my older brother.
My older brother is tall, handsome and hard-working. He is a college student studies in the best university in Taiwan now. I remember that he had told me, "After taking part of the foreign language camp of NTU, I had made up my mind to study hard in order to get into Tai-da." Then he made his dream come true. How I wish I could have the stable confidence like him.
He also plays basketball very well. He joins the school team and usually wins the championship. I like to watch NBA with him every weekend. It's a really great time. Although I can play basketball well, I also want to make more effort on my schoolwork. Maybe I can make my dream come true one day as well.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my father. When I was a child, my father taught me a lot of things, such as, English, math, music, or even sports. Almost everything was not difficult to him. I remembered one day my father taught me math in the morning, and we had played basketball and table tennis in the afternoon. At night, my father repaired my computer for me to play games. As I grew up, my father isn't energetic like before, but he always says " where there is a will, there is a way." he wish me to learn many things so that I can make contribution for the society. I respect my father very much, and I must realize his expectation to me. On the bottom of my heart, my father will be my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone loves idols that are like sportsmen, singers, actors and so on. People care everything about their favorite idols, like hobbies, favorite colors, foods or pets. The fans usually take many times in collecting idols' information and discussing with their friends. I liked singers before, but love movie stars now. Because they make the amazing show which attracts people's eyes on the screen. For this reason, I usually go to the theater to see a movie which is acted by my movie idols. It always make me feel happy. I wish my idols are happy, too.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has their idols, and so do I. My idol is a woman who is always with me and take care of me with all her heart. "She" is my mother. My mother is a traditional housewife. But she is a little different from others. She puts more emphasis on my morals than grades. She asked me not to tease those who is not beautiful and not to be proud when I have good performance in grades. Influenced by my mother, I have decided to be a person like my mother. And I won't forget what my mother teach me. She is my teacher for life. And she will be my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol, always just one in my mind and heart for my longlife, that is my beloved mother. It is said that weman are so fool that when a little baby was born, the woman as a mother will company her baby forever without any complain, and with their true love, so do my dear Mom. She is a superwoman, any problem through out her hand will disappear! She always simile at me, teach me, and love me. How amazing she is! I love and will company her for my longlife! My idol!

subject: IW-0802
content: When I was a little boy, lots of people asked me, "Who is your idol?", at that time, I even don't know what "idol" is. But now, I think I have found who my idol is. One day, I went to school, it was cold outside, but I forgot to bring my heavy coat. At that time, I saw someone running in the distance, that was my father, "Thank you, dad", I said, "Don't forget to bring your coat again, OK" dad asked, I nodded my head. That's my dad, he always helps me, when I need it; he teaches me English and piano; he teaches me to be a good student, let me have the chance to go to the APCC in Japan. Dad was my idol, and he will always be my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my English teacher. She's so clear and pretty. In class, she teaches very well, speaking correctly. She teaches me lots of article, telling me how to write an easay. Therefore I think of her as my idol. Our relationship is just as friends. We can chat everything as long as we just like. Futhermore, we don't have any secret between us. So I want to become as well as her. Overall, She is my idol, I'll try my best to became like her.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Chein-Ming Wang. He is a profession baseball player. He won nineteen wins last year and let me begin watching baseball game. His sinker ball made many MLB player hit a lot of grounballs and made little home runs. Though I couldn't go to America to watch him game and cheer for him, I has been captivated. I want to be a second Wang and play a perfect game, but it is impossible. However, I still hope one day I can go to New York to cheer for him and watch his interesting baseball game.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Now I like LM.C and Aqua-Timez most, who are the singer groups of Japan. I love their songs. Their types of songs are very differet. The styles of LM.C is like Rock and Rod. The other's style is relaxable which can make me feel enjoyable so that I can forget the pressure of school works.
To compare them to the singers of Taiwan, They are much better than Taiwan's singers. Taiwan's singers always write about love, they don't write about future planning, friendship. They aren't worth to listen and waste money. In the other hand, the groups of I like are more creative than Taiwan's. Even the rythm is worth to listen again and again. To sum up, LMC. and Aqua-Timez perform much better than Taiwan's.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I had my first idol when I was a junior high school student. I admired a
Taiwanese singer named Jolin. With an amazing look and a fashionable style, I admired her very much when she started to sing on a stage. In addition, I began to pursue her style, wearing clothes in fashion.
It was a crazy time that I pursued an idol just because of her pretty appearance. Gradually, I felt bored about admiring a person without any meaningful reasons, which only got me into a meaningless world. I tried to find a new idol I could learn from.
Now, I think the new idol is exactly my art teacher, who not only teaches me the skills of sketching and painting but also makes me find a new way of my own to face the life. Sometimes, he tells me some interesting stories, making me grasp the concept of what a happy and meaningful life is.
I really appreciate him for showing me a great attitude toward lives. I consider him as my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone may have his own idol, such as the singer, super star or millinair, but when it comes to the idol for me may be my teacher. Why my idol would be my teacher? He is my high school teacher, he always does his best to take care of his student no matter how tired it would be, the more fool student the more time he spent to teach him until the student realize it. For me his behavior is really teach my heart. When I learned about my teacher was born in a poor family but he has never give up, not only wanting more and more people would love study but hoping tell us just to do and you will get what you want. For me wanting to share the concept I've make up my mind to be a good teach.

subject: IW-0802
content:
When talking about the idol, without doubt, the person who I respect to is my father. My father is a doctor. He works at the hospital near our house. Though the hospital is near our house he doesn't have a dinner with us. He always say that the doctor is a career which have a great deal of responsibility to person who is sick. Therefore he should stay at the hospital all the time until the next doctor come to alternate.
What make me so like him is not only his attitude toward his job but his good temper. My father doesn't get angery in every situation, even his favorite cup broken by my brother. He always tell us the smile is a good medicine. To sum up, my father is my idol. I want to be a doctor like him who saves people's life, and I hope one day I would be a good doctor with good temper as well.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Beethoven, who is a famous musician. He became deaf in his late year. At first, he was afraid that he couldn't play the piano anymore, but he didn't want to give up. He made up his mind and overcame the difficulties. Some of his greatest works were even written after he became deaf. Life can't always be a bed of roses or in the path of ease and comfort. You need to have courage and face yourself. As a saying goes, "God helps those who help themselves". From Beethoven's example I learned that with your determination, you can live an active and meaningful life, and that's why Beethoven is my favorite idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is my father.
Why my favorite idol is my father, it's because that he teach me a lot of life concepts. For example, when I was a little boy, my father took me to a mountain, where was nearly my grandmother's home, the scences in the mountain was not only beautiful but also amasing, the trees were so thirve that we can't see another side. First, my father taught me how to know the direction. Second, he taught me what the plant name is. Finally, it's the most interesting and important memories of my life, he taght me how to swim in the river, why it's the most important thing. Because I love swimming. It's like my life, I want to thank my father. He not only keep us to grow up but also teach us the reality of life and the turth, So my father is my favority ideal and the central of my life.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I have lots of interest, such as: play basketball, listen to music, watch TV, drawing, and so on. So sometimes I want to expand my vision of my interest. I will read the newpaper, watch News, and get on the InterNet to get more information. I use these things to know the best one in each of my interest.
?? is a basketball player in Taiwan, He got high scores in each of his games. I admire his skill of basketball, and his hights. He is almost 205 cm. He's really a tall guy. I want he to share some hights. Because I only have 163 cm. It's not tall at all.
Jack Johnson is a singer in America. His popular in Taiwan. My friends and I really love him. Because his music is soft but happy. And his voice is comfortable. I like to listen his music when I take a bath or draw something. It make me relax and have more inspirations.
?? and Jack Johnson are both of my idol. I like not only their talents, but also like the feel what they let us feeling.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their own idol and of course I have one, too. My idol is my teacher - Kelly Lan.
Kelly is our class teacher and she is also our English teacher. She studied in a very famous college in America. She teaches really hard, I was in her class for two years already, she was never late or absent. Our class always got the highest score in the monthly test. Kelly isn't only a good teacher, she is also like a sister or even a mother. Sometimes, if I got bad score on the test or something else made me depressed, I will talk to Kelly and she can always cheer me up and made me feel confident again.
I'm not too bad at English, but I thought my English isn't good enough now, because I want to become a great English teacher like Kelly in the future, so I thought I should study English harder and harder from now on!

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is my frind and my family, who I called him "brother".
He is not smart, his grade is not very well, and he doesn't has a good-looking. But he is a good man.
He ever said that "I can do anything for you, my family." And he really do that. Just he can, he always do everything what I want he do. Nomatter buying something for me, driving me to somewhere, or fighting for me. Just I want, he will do that.
His friends love he, too. Because he is kind. If you have any problem, just call him for help. He will tell you what can yo do, and do his best to help you. I love him, not only because he is my family but also because he always do everything for me. He is my idol. Because he do everything I can't do. I can't help everyone who I know, but he can. I can't do my best to help somebody, but he can. I can't do anything just for somebody, but he can. The only person I ever know who always for his family and his friends, it's my brother.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my sister, Phoebe. Though she is not pretty and talent. She has a beautifu heart and always works hard. She is the one who always be in a good mood and who doesn't give up easily when facing difficultes. She always thinks in the positive way and trys hard to reach the goal. I like her not only beacuse she is presevered but also she is friendly to everyone around her. She always treats people generously and never says bad words. I am always proud of her. Because of her, I feel that everyone in my life is so nice and the world is so wonderful.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My aunt is always attracted to me. She now is fourty years old and single. She has created drawings and various hand-made goods by herself for about five years. Even last year, her teacher helped her prepare the eyhibition, it certainly appealed to many people.
How could I admire at her so much? I think self-confidence is the point. She always enjoys her life and does everything she wants. Meeting a problem, she never knows what keeping difficulties away is.
Eight years ago, my aunt had a terrible marriage and I could imagine how frustrated she was, but she just soon realized that she must have been tough and stood by herself. Like that courage to face one's life, by no means could everyone give up, no matter how upset they are. This is what I learned from my aunt's success and I would like to be more confident. Just as the proverb goes, "You help yourself first, and then everyone will help you."

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is Emily. She is an History teacher in my senior high school and I never seen this kind of teacher before.
In class, she asks us questions to trade us thinking ability. Due to her trade, I had a different kind of study way.
Because of her teaches, I know how to let knowledge in practice. And thanks her let me know "books are died, people are life."
Although she is a paitent, she didn't give up herself. She has a sens of humor and happily look around the world. She told me many advise in study or life. She is my idol, Emily.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Every day when I come home, the house is full of the smell of delicious food. I ran to the kitchen, a strong man stands there, preparing dinder for my sister and me. The strong man is my super idol - my father.
Since my mother was gone, my father has raised my sister and me on his own for two years. But Father never complains about that, he always says "Don't worry about it, we will make it through." Every time when I hear my father saying this, I always embrace Father with tears rolling on my check. I know that I am still pretty young, so I can't help Father to earn money to raise our family. All I can do for my father is study hard and enter the public university. Because of Father's perseverance, I will do my best to acheive the goal. So that is why I consider Father to be my super idol and the hands that keep our family safe and warm.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol
Nowadays, everyone should has an idol.
My idol is Jesus. There are three reasons why Jesus is my super idol. First of all, he is perfect. He never makes a mistake. Then, he loves everyone in the world.

He is not only loves children, he also loves some people who dislike him. Most important of all, he never gets angry with anyone. For example,

some bad guys would like to kill him. Jesus still forgives them. He treats everyone like his family. Also, Jesus always tells people "love each other" and do good things. There are three reasons why Jesus is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Soda Green. It is a band. There are five people in it. I like it because it has good songs. Its songs always come with soft melody, and sometimes come with jumping notes. In addition, the beat of its songs is easy to follow. Whenever I feel, its songs touch my heart deeply. If I am sad, I will listen to some of its songs to let the bad mood move away. When I am happy, I can not only listen to the energetic songs, but sing at the same time. The band gives me the bright side of life. The main singer's voice is really attractive. The lines in its songs are enchanting as well. There are so many advantages about it that I can't describe all of them. So, just go to buy its CDs, and you can enjoy a music feast.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Andy Lau since I was ten years old. He is not only a singer but also an acter. Andy Lau played so many movies and singed songs. Although he is so busy, he has his own company. He works very hard and never said any words about tired or something to complain. There is hardly to read the negitive news about Andy Lau in the newspaper. Most of his coworkers always say that Andy is a very very friendly person and being so kind. Everything he shows me in his life makes me feel that he enjoys life. Making things to be perfect is honor, not stress.
That's why I like him for so many years, And I think he will will be my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: When it comes to the idol I admire, it occurs to me that I used to admire Jolin. As is known to everyone, she is famous as a singer. A considerable quantities of juveniles have been enthusiastic about her beauty and figure, and I used to be no exception. With her industrious characteristic and perservance, she realized her dream, becoming a so-called twinkle star. She was my sister's schoolmate; as a consequence, I had known the person before she had her first album. The most difference between the past and the present is that she is still hardworking, even being superior to any other singers with high reputation nowadays. That is why I used to admire her most. From the real story mentioned above, I have learned that you will succeed provided that you work hard constantly.

subject: IW-0802
content:
One of favorite idol I think is Kobe Bryant. He is one of a basketball in NBA. He is so tall that one time he came to Taiwan for a vist, and I went to saw him. I can't see his head if I just look forward. So if I want to look at him, I need to raise my head.
There are two reason for me to like him. The first one is that every time if he don't show his talent on the stage. The Lakers will lose badly. But if he could play the game. Usually the Lakers will win. So I considered him as a basketball god in my mind. The second reason is that he is cool. The style of Kobe has deeply effect our thought. So when I walked in my senior campus, I can see lots of students cut the same hair as Kobe. Luckily, I'm one of those guy.
If I can, I hope I can do the same thing like him. Playing basketball all day and set so many people courage us no matter we win or lose. What a precious oppertunity.

subject: IW-0802
content: It is my friend, Ashely, that is my idol. She is not only mature, but also thoughtful. Although her father is our home room teacher, she does not rely on that relationship to be a disagreeable teenager. She always cheers me up when I am hurt by another classmate or when I don't do a good job on the science subject. I didn't know if a men can be so kind till I met her. She let me understand how beautiful the world is, and what I can do for other creatures. She is a good friend, a teacher and a landmark in my life. In my opinion, there is no other person can be my idol, expect Ashely.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My super idol was my homeroom teacher, he was not only a biologist but also a good teacher. He was humor and very kind to all of his students, everyone loves him very much, incuding me.
He was singal, I think that is why he spend a lot of time in education. All of us wanted to interduce a woman to him, but he always smailed and refuced. "Don't worry about me, I'm enjoy my singal life." he said, and we always laught.
But he got cancer in the year before last year, all of his students were astonishment, that was unbelievable to everyone. We praied, we cried, but he just passed away. That is why I believe it has Heaven in the world, I hope he can goes to the Heaven, and start another "happy singal life".

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol
When I was eleven years old, it was the first time that I saw my idol - Michael Jordan. He is a basketball super star. Because of his effort that let Chicago Bulls won the NBA Championship Six time! this is why I'm so like him.
In his career life, won: MVP of season, slam dunk awards et all. His perfect player spirit make me love this sport. Otherwise, I not only saw the NBA games, but also practised my basketball skill in my leisure time. I was benefited from basketball that also let me loss my weight about fifteen kilograms and taller than before.
I think that Jordan have a special position in my whole life. Although Jordan was retired for several years. He is the idol who I favorite until now. I would like remember Jordan's saying, "As far as ability is concerned, you are second to none!" in my mind.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is a young girl singer who called Jolin. Because of my age is getting older, so whe I see her proformance on TV, she really make me fell younger and active again.
And also I know her major in her colleage was English, no wonder she can speak English very well. I think Jolin is not only a pretty girl but also smart. So , I would encourage my child if you wanted be a idol or super star, at first you need to study hard. And then try new things hard. Although it might be a tough job, but Jolin did it, and maybe my child can do it to. I just share my idea with my child.
Nowaday, many young people and even old people likes Jolin very much. I think that's because she really work hard and want be a professional singer, I guess many people would agree too.
So, I hope many singers in Taiwan, they can be a good example, because every kids would learn many things form them.
So , I support Jolin and recommand her CD's forever and ever!

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone must have an idol, and so do I . My idol is so close to me - my elder sister. I consider her as my idol because that she sis a perfect girl. She is clever, gentle, patient, and also beautiful. When I have some questions of my school tasks, she will help me to solve them at one time. When I against to do something I must to do, she will ask me to face them. When I fall into the hole of sadness and sorrow, she will lead me out of the darkness. When I feel lonely and painfully, she will keep me from the bad mentions. When I have some enemies, she will stand at the same side of me. When I am happy for something, she will smile with me. That sounds not like the reason of look her as an idol. But for me, because she can complete the thing that I can't achieve, that's why I think she is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people has someone who likes, me too. I like a baseball player call Chieh-Ming Wong. He is a pitcher in MLB team New York Yankees. It is a best team in Major League. It is the most valueable team of all teams. It's total salary of a year can afford our country pro baseball league about 30 year.
Wong was a very famous pitcher when he was high school in taiwan. He could make a lot of fast ball in game, so he could made control about games. When he graduated from high school, he decided went to USA to improve his skill. When he got to America last twe years, he got hurt because of he made to much pitch while he was young. He made two times of Tomy John's climics to renew his arms. After a long time recomductor , he came back the ground. Now he is the most important start pitcher of Yankees. The team need he win lots of game to come to the play off. And hope to win the world seris to make a championship.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is my best friend.
I met him at school and got a big surprised by him. He is almost good at everything, such as play the drum, write the story, etc.
That's why I admire him as well.
His guitar skill is very perfact, and with his voice and music, all others of us are enjoy the time he singing always.
I'm oppsite from, shy and weak.
Afraiding to show myself to the people, and also worry about facing others.
To over this obstacle, I'm learning from him now.
Wish I can be such a great person one day.
Until then, I can face people without any horror.
I will not only be a admirer, but a perfomer to show what I've got and who I am.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has an idol to honor and to respect. Not except me. My idol is Kobe Bryant. He's a basketball player in NBA, which has all the best basketball players in the world. When he was a child, he started to play basketball with his father. His father was the first basketball teacher of his life. And when he grew up as a teanager. He joined the basketball team and found his way to have achievement. By his hard practice, he finally participated in NBA. Even if he's only a senior high school student.
He has the best life and everyone who likes to watch NBA is crazy for him. But he's never as proud as a peacock. That's why he can be my idol. He always says, "We're a team, and I'm just a part of it." Although he has some problems which the team he took part in can't win in the game. But I believe he can solve the problem and lead the team. To win the NBA champion, no one can replace to him.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Judy Chung, who is a queen of Taiwanese songs. She was born in a poor family and had many sisters and brothers. In order to earn more and more money and feed her sisters and brothers, she didn't go to school instead of she go to work. She sang songs in many local resterants. Although she didn't go to school to study, she knew that her hard work will never give in vain. As the proverb goes "As you sow as you grow." She became a star in Taiwanese songs. She sang many hot songs, such as The voice of the falling rain, The wife, and The love. Her voice is really caught me. I really like her spirit in her life. I think it was a hard time but she underwent it and through it. I love Judy Chung not only her special voice and her songs but also her kindness and how she treats others. Although she's a queen of Taiwanese songs, she didn't seem to a queen ask others do anything for her. She very likes to give some guidence for beginners. I think I can't be Judy 2 because I can't speak any Taiwanese. But I like her personality and style. That is what I need to learn and what I love. Many people have their dreams, most important of all is to fulfill it.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has an idol or lots of idol, I'm not exception. My idol is my brother. He is a handsome boy, has a wise brain and a gentle temper. He is popular with his friends becuuse he is alway considerate and passionate to help others.
I have a bad habit, I can't concentrate on my schoolworks. After school, I am always playing computer or watching TV. Due to this bad habit, my grade is much worse. I am envy my brother, because he can focus on everthing he have to do. He knows I have the bad habit, so he suggested me writing homeworks and studying beside him. He says if I have any problem, he can teach me. I am lucky to have a intelligent and considerate brother, I want to learn him. So, I consider my brother to be my idol, I hope someday I can be as excellent as him.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Eason Chen, who is one of the most famous singer in Taiwan.
Like other students, I have to got to cram school and stay up late. For the purpose of getting relaxed, I always listen Eason Chen's songs. Apart from other singers, his singing skill is fascinated and the tones have enchanted me so much. Maybe he is not very handsome, but I don't regret to become his fans.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I like to watch a baseball game on live. I have been played the baseball since my childhood. I have a baseball idol. His name is C-M-Wang.
Wang not only a baseball player but also a king of baseball. In Taiwaness's heart. We proud or him. Why he is so effective? Because he is the most game winner, he is the first Taiwan good player in MBA, he is the best pitcher in Yankee.
I like him because he always silence, courage and handsom. He is very young but the old not respent everything. He is the top of Taiwan pitcher. He never proud of his business. He status will always on the top of Taiwaness.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is Utada Hikaru. She is a Japanese singer. I like her because of many results. First result, her voice is special. How special? Her voice can be very low, and can be very high as well. The other result is her music. She has many kinds of music stysles. For example, Rock, Pop, Jazz, and so on. The third result, all of her songs were wrote by herself. My favorite song, Hikari, was wrote by herself, too. The last result is because her English. She was lived in New York when she was young. So her English is so well that I disbelief she is a Japanese when I first heard her English song. That's why I like her. She will be my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my father. I know that many people regard popular singers or actors as their idols, but I think my dad is my idol. Despite the fact that he is not the most handsome man in the world, he is the best in my mind. He can do many things by himself, such as cooking and making some furniture. He is also a nice husband. He always helps my mom do the household work. When my sister and I have difficulties, he will come out of the solutions to those problems. What a good father he is! Maybe he isn't the best person in other's mind, but I think he is the best dad.

subject: IW-0802
content:
If you ask me who is my favorite singer, I would tell you I am not sure. But if you ask me about athletes, I would not hesitate and tell you "Vince Carter".
Vince is a basketball player playing in NBA. He showed his amazing altitude in basketball since he was only a teenager. And especially his dunk skill, many experts think even "Michael Jordon" can not match him.
I remember Vince finished a powerful dunk by his teamate's assist in the first NBA game I watched. This scene has been vivid in my mind and made me love basketball and the super basketball star.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My Super Idol
There is no doupt that every one have their own idol and aspire to staying with their idol forever, including me.
In my opinion, my Mom is my idol. We can talks so many things, from food to friends. Often we go window shopping and go to eat exotic food. As I was upset she encouraged me and let me know how important to not look myself down. I think that she is not so much a Mom but as a friend. Maybe it is because she born me when she was 20. So, we don't have generation jap.
I cherish the relationship between she and me. I want her to being my Mom forever. As far as I am concerned, my Mom is the most beautiful Mom in the world. Mom, you are always the best friend to me and I am terribly love you!

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has idol, including me. The idol can be a super star or sportsman and so on.
My idol is a president-elected "Mr. Ma". Mr. Ma is not only handsome but also strong. He is graduated from the famous university, NTU, and also studied abroad. He is major in Laws. Therefore, he is honest and justice.
I admire Mr. Ma, because he is very intelliect and hard-working. He always puts Taiwanese benefits on first. Besides, he likes jogging, and so do I. That is why he always can keep a good health. And his capability has earned him a place in Taiwanese heart. That is why Mr. Ma is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Jolin. I like her because she is very positive and also work hard, beauty is no exception. I always pay attention to news, which relation with her. When I went to bookstore, I usually look at many covers with her picture. Jolin is popular to nowadays people. She always take long time to prepare to new album. Every one of album are consume her year, because she always practice many difficult performs. Everyone are worried to her safe. However, she merely worry about no one would get married to her. She works hard on everything that is why I like her so much. She usually say "If you can, you can!" I will remember the scentence forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their idols, and so do I. My idol is my father. When I was a little girl, my father had traveled around the world. He is a businessman, and for his job, he has to go to every country alone the year.
"Practice makes perfect" is the phrace that he always talks to me. He hopes that one day I can be the person that never give up. Now, although he was dead for many years, I still remember the things that he told me the phrace and he wanted me to be the preson that never give up. I will never forget it and my special idol, my father.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Almost many people has idol, one or two or many. They are almost celebrities. I have an idol but he is not a celebrity. He is just a friend of mine.
Why he is my idol? There has three reasons. First, he is an outgoing person and has a good society ability with everybody.
Second, he always helps people who are in need or even though they are just strangers. And the last one is that he always got good grades in class
Though, he is not a famous celebrity, but he is still my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
There are many idols in everyone's mind, including athletes, actors . They are also an important play in everyone's life.
When I was in an elementary school, my idol is my grandpa. He is very handsome and he is tall. I hope that I will be a man like him. When I was in a junior high school, my idol is my classmate whose schoolwork was the best in our class. He is smart and mature in every thing. Now, my idol is myself. So I believe that I will be a somebody in someday, every relatives have confidence on me and consider I am a special person in our family.
As I am growing up, my idol is also changing. In different age, My personality and destination are also different. All in All, idols are important in everyone's life, because they help everyone realize their dreams.

subject: IW-0802
content: I liked the person who was humer and sinciety, and the person I said was my friend Rachel. She was not rich and beautiful, in other words, she was just a common girl. The reason why I liked her was really simple because the way she treated people like her family members and she always had a big smile on her face. The first time I talked to her was an accident. Because I was a new classmate in the class that I didn't know every things about the school. Thanksfully , she told me all the vital priciples about the school and we quickly became best friends. I really liked her and I even learned the way she speaking and wearing! How crazy I was!

subject: IW-0802
content:
The most idol I liked was Benjermin Washindon, who was called "The First American" . The reason why I liked him was because the domination he did in the world. For example, he discovered the lightening was the same of the electronic, and then invented the " lightening rade", which also existed on all the apartment nowadays.
Why people always called Benjermin Washindon " The First American"? It was because that he worked hard everytime. When he was working , he also paid attention on what he worked, which caused him great achievement. That was his personality!
Nowadays, when I studied at school, I also concentrated on what I read. That was the center thoughts of Benjermin Washindon, my favorate idol!

subject: IW-0802
content:
I like to play basketball and watch NBA on TV. My favorate player is Steve Nash. He plays the game for Phenix Suns, also my favorate basketball team, too.
Steve Nash is regard as a leader in the team. As he joined the Suns, he leaded the team to a climx what the Suns never got in the past three years. He have clearly three-point-shot and great ability of passing the ball. Without Steve Nash, the competition of the Suns usually lose. That's why I like him.
It is very sad that I can't see the game at the US. It needs much money because the tickit is very expensive. In addition, it needs a good ability in English. As I had a good ability in English, I could make money much easier and that I could have much more chanes to go to the US!

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Obama, who is the American president candicate. He has a amiable smile and tender voice. I have know him not for a long time. However, I was really attracted by him, and now, he is the idol in the depth of my heart.
The first time I saw him was when he delivered his speech which was about his expectations of the America. Through the speech, I felt that he was a person with strong mind, hoping to change his fellow's life. And the most important of all, he is true. Those qualities are why I love him so much. How can I stop admiring such a good person? I think he is the best politician I have ever known.

subject: IW-0802
content: There are many kinds of famous people in the world. For example, the dancers, singers, and artists. W-inds was my favory idols and thery are Japaness. When I was a high school student, I really like them. W-inds is a team and composed with three people. One of them is a great singer and he is more popular than other. However, the singer wasn't my favory idol. Actually the dancer was my favory idol. He is an exterm dancer. I very like his dance and his smile. At that time, I had all of their CDs inculded their first CD. Also I had his pictures in my computer. W-inds was my first idol and I really like them in my high school life.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My mother is my most admirable idol. She seems ordinary, but to me, I think she is the most extraordinary woman in the world. She really influences me a lot. She is a considerate housewife. She prepares hearty meals and does the household chores every day, but never has she complained about the monotinous works. She also makes the bathroom clean and almost immaculate in order to give us a comfortable environment.
I admire my mom so much because she always listens to my happy experiences and sadnesses and gives me advices and comforts. She also respects my opinion and will not compel me to do the thing I don't want to so I can have my own space and be myself. In spite of the fact that she has seldom limited me, I will always do my best and spare no efforts to achieve my goal. I'm really thankful to my mom for everything she does for me.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite movie star is Jay Lee. The type of feature he performs is Kung-Fu movie. Every shows are masterpiece in particular the "The One." The story is telling that a men againsts another person who looks some as him in order not to let the whole world breaking down. In this show, he needs to perform two person who have different personality. I think this is a challenge to him. I also like to watch martial art novels. But I would rather go to a movie than watch novels. Because it is more excited to watch than imagine by yourself. Jay Lee's movie is good!

subject: IW-0802
content:
My Favorite Idol
I have a lots of idols, but one of my favorite idols is Wang. I parctice baseball everyday just because I wan to approach Wang's achievement. Hence, Wang is not only my favorite idol, but everyone's idol. Wang burns in Tainan and starts to play baseball very young. I admire him for a long time, but my favorite was my mother in the past. When I was young, I thought of that my mother was my god. She could do every what I wanted her to do. That's why my favorite idol was my mother in the past. I make up my mind , I will become Wang and make everybody admire me. As the proverb goes "There is a will, There is a way."

subject: IW-0802
content: Since I was a child, my mother is the only idol that I appreciated. She is a beautiful and strong woman. As a working mother, she never foget about her children, me and my brother. She always as busy as a bee, but all the work she do is just perfect. I love the way she comb my hair, softly and carefully, just like a magician. As I grew up, we had fights some time. But she know I didn't meant to do that, so she just let me calm and told me where did I go wrong. She is the most lovely mother in the world, I love her so much. That's why she is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Michael Jordan, who was a basketball player in the NBA. He got MVP five times and let his team Chicaco Bulls took six times championship. I liked to watch him playing basketball on TV.
Why he is my idol? Because of his hard working. Everday he is the first one arrive the court and he is the last one leave the court. The hard working made him become the best player in the NBA. When he first time leave NBA to play baseball, my heartbroken because I thought I couldn't see him playing basketball any more. But two years later he was back, when he was back to NBA many people said "he was too old to play basketball." However, he showed those people who said he was old that he still could jump as tall as before. He said "What is love? Playing every game for the last. He did his best in every game. He needed to shoot the last ball many times, he believe himself that he can success. That's why he is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Some people consider it stupid to worship idols, however, as far as I'm concerned, we can all acquire some precious experience and look upon our idols as a model we struggle to live up to.
My favorite idol is David Jao. He created a special music style which bounces between R&B, folk music and pop. Due to his background, his music is a mixure of Chinese and Western style. His music comforts me in pain and suffering, fill my mind with joy, turn hours of weariness into moments of delight. My imagination siars with those enchanting melodies. Most importantly, his music always delivers some messages, about the world we live in, about ordinary people's stories, and about love. He tells us that love is to humans what water is to fish. He shows great concerns to our society through such charming music.
Despite all his achievements, he remains humble. Being such a successful singer, he keeps working tirelessly and even pursues his dream as a director. While admiring him, it spurs on me to work persistently, to contribute to the world, and to express our love to our society.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My mother is always my idol. My mother has short hair, and big eyes. She is not very tall and she always wears glasses. My mother can draw very well. She is also good at hand made stuff.
I love my mom because she always takes care me and my brother. She always gives us the best such as education. She cleans our house very often, she made our home very tidy. She is also very democratic, she never stops me or my brother to do anything except for dangerous things. She never spoils me and my brother. My mother has a good heart, she helps a lot of people, not only me and my brother, but her friends and family as well.
I think my mom is the best mom in the world. I want to be like her when I have my own children. I would like to love my children with my whole heart just like my mom does.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have favorite idol, not only actors, sportmen or writters, bus also people who are always by your side.
At the past, my favorite idol is A-mei. She is a singer. Her songs are not just good listioning, but also full of energy and powerful.
Now, I love Linken Park's music. It songs has power and teach me many things. Then I will not give up thing at the half.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Zidane is my super idol, who is thought of as one of the greatest football players in the world.
Unlike many celebrities, Zidane lived in an impoverished family, so he didn't take the chance to learn the football skills by private coach. But he really is a genius at football, and he developed his interest in football in an early age. With his persistence and passion, he became famous as a teenager, but he didn't stop there and start partying. He kept practicing and tried hard to improve his skills, and he has done it.
Being a football star, he doesn't live a luxory life, he has a commercial for a cheap supermarket, where he always bought stuffs while he was a child, and he donated a lot of money to many charities.
That's why I like him, a persistent, passionate, humble and kind super star.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has his or her own super idol. For example, some people want to become a baseball star, just like Mr. Wang, hoping one day they can stand in the baseball court in America. Others want to sing and dance as well as Jolin. As for me, it is my mother that I respect the most.
My mother takes care of us three children very hard. In the early morning, she needs to call all of us to go to work or school. Then, she starts to do all the chores. After that, she goes to work. Just like a routine, she does these things again and again. You may wonder that where is my father? My father doesn't work hard and always stays at home. In addition, he is sometimes in a bad mood. When I grow up, my mother affects me a lot. Most people want to become like their idol someday. However, my mother encourages me to have different life between hers. I know I need to be more independent hereafter.
If you pay more attention to you idols, you must know that what's more important is his or her effort before, rather than their success now. As a result, if you have any dream, you need to work hard just from now.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I had some idols in the past, the writter, the singer, the person who is the book's character. The most affect me was the writter whose name is Mattie. He was a child with an unhealthy body. He wrote a lot of poem and licture. The poems he wrote told us how he wants to live longer, what he wants to do if he had a healthy body. But he died 2 or 3 years ago. He tolds me that I have a healthy body and I can do many things. I can travel. I can read. I can help the people who need me.
But now I have more and more idols. There is many people I can learn something from them. My friend who is concentrates at her study. The teacher who knows a lot about history. The people who always helps me. And my mother and father, they always working hard for offer my life and give me a warmily house.
There could be many idols just around us not only at television or books. We have a lot to learn from the people beside us.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is my mom. She is not a famous person, but a superwoman to my family. She's always busy about taking care to family, and takes family at first place. No matter how tire after work, the first thing she does is doing houswork like washing clothes, preparing dinneretc. She always wakes up early and goes to bed late. I seldom see her do something for herself.
Sometimes my brother and I want to help her to do some work. But she always tells us that we should study hard for our future and no waste too many times on other things. In the past I would leave away, but not I have grown up. I can't let my dear mother do all the things. I also can do something not only my family but my mom.
Mother's Day is coming. My brother and I are preparing a big party for my mother. We not only want to thanks her but want to tell her that we are adult, and we can do the thing for our family and ourself. It it time for you to take break. We love you, mom.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has his idol. The person must have a big influence on him. I'm no exception. The person I admire most is Kate, my homeroom teacher. She is independent, always finishes many things by herself, and does them perfectly. For all the people in our class, Kate is the soul of the class. We had an important English drama when I was in the first grade in senior high. Although we knew it was of great importance, we still didn't work very hard, then Kate scolded us seriously. At that time, we just thought that Kate was very serious and mean, but we didn't see her efforts in her back: she rented the stage in private, solved the microphone problem and prepared the play's background for us. She never complains about something. She is a really good teacher. I wish I could be a teacher like her in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content: In my opinion, everyone has a favorite idol in their mind. I am no exception. My super idol is not well-known celebrity, but she has deep effect on me. That is my high school teacher. I take a liking for her class and learned more about knowledge from her lesson. In the other hand, my teacher always tells us many her own experiences of life. After listening those, I may think deeply about my life and those precious experiences are good for me. She always say "Rome wasn't built in a day", so everyone should work hard to make your dreams come true. And I like this saying much. To sum up, she is very important for me. I am glad to meet such a good teacher.

subject: IW-0802
content: As far as I'm concerned, everyone may have their appreciated idols. For me, it may sound strange. I am not similiar with most of the people regard movie stars or singers as their idols. My mother is my favorite idol. She can't sing and perform, but she always cares for me. When I fail in examination she never gets angry, and she encourages me, instead. As I make mistakes, she tells me what I am wrong and teaches me the correct way. How considerate my mother is! My mother is always busy, but I don't think she nelects me. She usually deals with things on time and that is what I want to learn from her. I think my mother plays an important role in my life. She is not only my mother but also my teacher and my favorite idol. I love my mother forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their favorite idols in their mind, such as Cheng-Ming Hwang or Michael Jordan. When I was in high school, my favorite idol was a Japanese group, W-inds.
At the first time, I watched their MV on TV, I thought they were sissy. But I didn't know why I fell in love with them after then. I bought anything about them, for example, CDs, DVDs, VCDs, and the books written their childhood. And my favorite person of W-inds was Keita. Because I could really learn his efforts from watching the DVDs or reading newspapers. Because seeing them for a long time, his efforts couraged me to be serious at what I had to do, like my schoolwork. I did my best on my schoolwork. I felt that myself efforted with Keita. Although I have ever liked W-inds very much, now I don't like them anymore, and I don't know why. But the inspirt always courage me consistantly. Now I am searching for another idol who I can learn from him/her!

subject: IW-0802
content:
It is common for the young to have his or her own idols. It seems to be a crazy and difficult to understand thing for many adults. But it is my belief that everyone should has a so-called idol for him or her when he or her was young. It is because that when we are young, we often don't understand what we want and what we want to become in the future. If we have our own idols, we can imitate and study many things from them. That will help us to grow up or make progression in many aspects of what we lack.
When I was eighteen, I liked a female idol from Japan very much. I felt that she was very lovely and had charming personal characteristics. She sang songs very well and so did the drama she acted in. Now I realize that I liked her so much because I regarded her as the ideal girl friend. I know that I used to be too shy to make a girl friend and did not know what qualities I liked being my future girl friend.
Although many people have their own idols to study or to like. I think it is not a good idea to spend too much time on it. We should learn something important for us from them and thus we can really become a better person in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people may has an idol, and so do I. I like SHE - the famous girl singer's group. The member of the group are three girls - Slina, Hebe, and Ella. Each girl has a different style and personality.
First, Slina has a kind heart and likes to reach out to those who need help. Besides her personality, her dress and hair style are what I like to follow. Second, Hebe is the youngest and must attractive girl. She is so witty, humor and beautiful that she has mostly boys' fans. Ella is a girl whose act, behavior are similar to boys. Also, she always be the group's happiest person to liven up the matephor.
I like them because they are so special to me, and I wish one day I can follow their steps to be a celebrity.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have an idol in their heart, and so do I. My idol is neither an artist nor a sports player, but a famous author named J.R.R. Tolkien.
"The Lord of the Rings" is the most popular series of books of his. Millions of people have read the book, however, few people know how did the idea of this book bumped into Tolkien's mind. Tolkien was a professor teaching in the Oxford University in England. While he was viewing the test paper after an examination, he found a piece of paper completely empty. He wrote down a strange sentence mindless, then the sentence made him start to write the story.
In the story, he created a world that he called "Secondary-world". It meant that it was as true as the real word. When the first time I read his book, I was shocked and almost paralyzed. Just like being hypnotized, I became his fan and was crazy about his creation. I even anticipate myself becoming a novelist of fantasy literature.
Tolkien passed away about fifty years ago. That "The Lord of the Rings" was called "The book of 20 century" showed his success. J.R.R. Tolkien is eternally my most respectable idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: Jay Chou, a great singer, is my favorite idol. I listen to his music every day. I went to his concerts for seven times, and I watched all of his movies. These are the reasons why I love him so much: Firstly, Jay is a creative singer and a talented movie directer. The style of his music and his movies are always different from others, but always give people lots of surprise. Secondly, I like his touching voice. He uses all his heart to sing songs. Last but not least, Jay never gives up. There are many articles on the net regarding his hard work. He came from a poor family. At first, he worked as a waiter in a restaurant. Then, he played piano for customers. Now, he is one of the greatest singer in Asia. An old saying goes: "Genius is ten percents aspiration and ninety-nine percents perspiration." Jay proved it. For these reasons, I love Jay very much, and I'll always support him.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is my aunt. Though she isn't a famous person, I like her very much. I borned when she was eighteen years old. She took care of me when I was a child; therefore, we are just like sisters.
She is very pretty and smart, she studied abroad before and she used to live in many countries. Her English is very good. Studying abroad is my dream, because I can learn many different culture and think in another language; in addition, you will think in a different point of view. But I know it isn't as easy as I think. I think my aunt is really brave. Living in another country is a difficult thing because you don't know anyone there. You can only do everything by yourself. That's why my idol is my aunt.
I have to work hard to fullfile my dream. I want to do as well as my aunt did. After all, it is my life, I won't waste my time. I'll do my best!

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is the famous basketball star, Kevin Garnett. Not only his gorgeous skill but also his passion make me be his big fan.
Kevin has loved basketball since he was a kid. "He used to play basketball from 4 or 5 clock to the middle of the night when he was in elementary school." said Kevin's grandma. By his diligence, Kevin was picked on the NBA draft after he finished his high school study. Everyone was so surprised to believe how dared the Timerwolves choose a eighteen-year-old kid, but Kevin showed that he was so tallent and dilligent to play well. Soon, he became a All-Star player.
On the courts, we can see Kevin played so hard but the Timerwolves couldn't win the game. "I want to make this team better and better, that's what drove me." said Kevin. Kevin does love the Timberwolves, but he just couldn't win the championship. The boss of the Timberwolves was so upset and hopeless, so he traded Kevin to Boston Celtics. After Kevin played for the Celtics, he became a big hero. He made the Celtics lead the league, they may win more than 60 games this season. Everyone believes that Kevin will lead the Celtics to win his first championship this season. Wish they can made it and Kevin can show that he is still so valuable.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their idols, such as movie stars, popular singers, famous writers, and athletes. I also have my favorite idol but my favorite idol is different from others. My idol always takes care of me and rises me up since I was born. That's right! My mother is my most favorite idol in the world. My mother isn't a housekeeper. She works in the junior high school. Although she is busy working, she always cooks dinner and breakfast for us.
My mother is good at work and housework. She never let us worried about her. In spite of she isn't perfect in other's mind, she is the most wonderful mother and my most favorite idol in my mind.

subject: IW-0802
content: The idol who I respect is my band teacher. I like him very much because of his attitude of his dream. He has learned playing the instrument when he was in senior high school. Later, he entered the best university in Taiwan. After two years, he found that he was interested in music. Therefore, he made up his mind to realize his dream. To prepare for the difficult test, he studied very hard and went to the library very often. Although everyone thought his decision was stupid, he never gave up making his dream come true. Because of his hard work, he entered another university with a very high score. Everyone who had laughed at him was surprised. He has made an unbelieveable success in his life. He, my band teacher, is my favorite idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Chien-Ming Wang. He is a baseball player of Major League Baseball. I like him because of his confidence and courage. When I watch his pitch, I am usually inspired by his performance. Even though being hit, he still continue to face the next hitter with his whole energy. I think I should also never scare any difficulty in my life.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has his favorite idol, and I am no exception. When it comes to my idol, I will say Jin without hesitation. Jin is my classmate. The reason why I support him is that he is a diligent and considerate person. He never fly into a rage or shout at people. Instead, he is a gentle man and always give a hand to others with a charming smile on his face. Consequently, every students in my class are willing to make friends with him. I have never met such a kind person like him until I knew him. I think I would stand up for him no matter what happens and I wouldn't forget him even if I graduate from school.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Since I was a little girl, I have been charmed by her. She is the most beautiful woman I have ever seen. She always gives me some available advice whenever I don't know what to do. She keeps our house neat and takes care of me carefully. She is my mother.
Because of work, my dad left me when I was ten and now, he lives in China. My dad only comes to Taiwan once a month. However, I have never heard that my mom complains to him. She still gives me a very warm family. She doesn't have job. When I go to school, she just stays at home alone, cleaning the house and preparing dinner for me. She teaches me and relizes what I really want to have.
I'll never leave my mother. I love her and she is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have an idol. The idol can be a movie star, an athlete, a writer and so on. They can also be people by your side. I have an idol, too. He is a popular baseball player, and now he is in America playing MLB. Do you know who is him? Yes, he is the most powerful pitcher "Cheng-Ming-Wang".
There are two reasons why I love Cheng- Ming-Wang as my idol. First of all, he can play baseball well and he is the best pitcher I've ever seen. He improved his skills, and won thirty-eight games for two years. Not only Taiwanese love him but also American. On the other hand, he has a very good attitude. When he lose in a game, he never gets angry. He is always calm, not like other players who always say himself as a strongest player.
Because of the reasons above, that's why I love Cheng-Ming-Wang as my idol. I hope one day I can be a pitcher as powerful as him, and I believe my dream will come true.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Idol
Many people have their own idols. Some people like movie actors and actresses, and the others like writers and directors. I think my idol is Chien-Ming Wang, "the Glory of Taiwan."
Chien-Ming Wang is an MLB pitcher. He has pitched in MLB for 2 years. He has won almost 40 games already because he practices hard and never gives up easily. When facing perfect hitters, he still can make them out with "sinker", a kind of baseball techniques. Although he has difficult situations, he can deal with them without being nervous. His spirit is what we have to learn. All of the Taiwanese are proud of him. That is why I think Chien-Ming Wang is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have idols, besides celebrities, sports players or authers, and there are some people around our side. However, I have no idols, and I have several reasons for it.
First of all, idols are human, and human will make mistakes and get old. They are not perfact. Although I know that nobody has not shortcuts, I can't accept the true about my idol's mistakes. Furthermore, people will get old and their appearance will be not as beautiful as they were young. I feel sad that times fly. I think that puppets or characters in the fiction novels could be my idols forever. In the fiction world, they are so excellent that I really attract by them.
Perhaps you will not agree my opinions, but I accept that some people have their idols. Having idols, they will have dream and promote themselve to chase on their goals. Nevertheless, I don't have idols, but I also keep on my friends' pases and be on the way of my dream. Some people need idols to inspire them in the boring daily life, but the others feel that the world has so many interesting this, and they want to walk on themselves' way.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite movie star is Ralph Fiennes. He is a English actor. I like him because of his personality and his face. He is a famous actor in UK. The first time I had a crash on him was the movie named "Onegin". Actually I like him not just for his pretty face. I adimir him deeply, I feel comfortable when I watched the movie he played. Because of him I will go to England and live there until I see him. In my mind I hope I can meet someone like him in the future. My mission now is to do my best and then I can move to England as soon as possible.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is Mitch Album. He is a famous author who wrote "Tusedays with Morri", "Five people you meet in the heaven" and "For one more day".
The books that he wrote is always full of meaning. I can learn a lot of things in his books. He talk about life meaning, love, family and friendship. I learn those knowledge that I can't learn in school. When I read his book, I feel he is cheering me up. I always want to be a author like he is. Let the readers feel they meet the author face-to-face, just like sharing expirence with each other, talk about their career, lives and feeling. I can feel that while I am reading his books so Mitch Album is my idol. I will keep reading his books in the future. Maybe someday I will be a great author as he is.

subject: IW-0802
content:
There are many celebrities in Taiwan Entertainment Industry. Jolin is one of them, and she impresses me very much.
There are many reasons for why I love Jolin. First, she has a perfect appearance. She is so beautiful that every photo in magazines or newspaper looks pretty well. Second, she has a good voice. Everytime when I feel blue or sad, I always want to listen to her music. Her songs have a power to relieve my bad mood. Last but not the least, she is hard-working. She is famous now, but she used to be not. She is not a gifted star, but she knows what is her weakness. She always faces critics and improves. And now, she is one of the well-known stars in Taiwan.
I learn from Jolin a lot. I know that when facing barriers I can't give up. Jolin is always my favorite idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol
Everyone has their own idol in their mind. My idol is my mother. For most people, she is not a special woman, but for me, she is the best mother in the world. She not only have a job, but also have to take care our family. When I got a problem, she always listen to me and tell me what to do. Othewise, when her friends got a problem, they will also ask my mother to give them advice. Everybody truth my mother and share everything about them to my mother. This is not a easy job to let people truth you. That's why my idol is my mother.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their super idol, expect the singer, basball player or writer. It is possible that the idol is your good friends. I like a singer who can play the guitar very well. He is very famous, not only American are talking about him but also Japanese want to see him. He always dress in black and wear jeans. He sings so great that I can't stop listening his songs. I believe that he will be a great singer in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is Miley Cyrus. She is the main character in a disney program, "Hannah Montana." In that program, she shows her talents of acting and singing. What's more, she also writes a lot of songs that are good to listen.
I love her not only due to her beauty, but her way of thinking. Her hand-writing songs always encourage me. As I am angry at someone or feel depressed, listening to her songs can make me feel better. Perhaps life isn't that perfect, sometimes we even feel hopeless and exhausted. However, I am supposed to try my best to be optimistic as Miley Cyrus is!

subject: IW-0802
content: I have many idols. One of them, my favorite singer is Super Junior. Not only do I love their songs, but also their lyrics of the music attract me a lot. Why do I say that? I was far from the music lesson while I was in junior high school. Our teacher was always forced us to do lots of performs upon music, especialy singing. I'm not good at singing, so when I had no idea of my singing test. Suddenly I heard a beautiful love song from an TV show. I was bent on singing the song from TV show in the music class; eventualy, I passed my singing test. Then I searched for the songs and knew the singer of this love song is Super Junior. I'm grateful for their songs that let me pass the test and I am very crazy for them now.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Nowadays, many people in Taiwan are for idol worship. Some teenagers are crazy about the movie stars, singers, dancers, and so on. However, my favorit idol is my mother.
I do not have a father since I was born. My mother takes good care of me by herself. Her personality is very nice and open-minded. When I feel stressful on my school performance, she always supports me and gives me good advices. Furthermore, she is a good friend of mine as well. We can do a lot of things together, such as going shopping, seeing movies, etc. The most important thing is that we can talk without a generation gap. To me, my mother is the greatest woman in the world. She is my super idol certainly.

subject: IW-0802
content:
When it comes to idols, I had nothing to say with it serveral years ago. But the things changed. Last year when I was watching TV, a japanese singer caught my eye, his name is Gackt.
At first, I thought he was just a handsome guy, but after listening to his latest album, I really enjoyed his music! After that, I searched for his imformation on the internet. I read a lot of things about him, and listen to his songs. I didn't like rock music very much, but his music changed my sight.
Gackt's concept to the music is "Singing to myself, and everyone who loves me." He's very kind to his fans, and read all the letters they wrote for him. Now, I use to listen one of his song before I go to bed. I think I will always support him!

subject: IW-0802
content:
