I like her because of her prefect vioce. She can sing all kinds of songs and preform them very well. Her voice is very powerful and fasinating. She can also dance very well, her dancing is not only energetic but also sexy. These years, she undergoes something bed in her life and has no new album but she is not knock down by these terrible things. She is going to preform a musical drama. She become a perfect entertainer. She can sing, dance and even act. She also goes to some poor country to help the poor children and donates lots of money to the poor. She is a wonderful person, isn't she. That's why I love her.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their own idols in their mind. The idols that they worship might be writers, singers, sport players, etc. The reason that we worship them could be features, beautiful voice or romatic poems.
Everyone has a idol. Like me, my idol aren't anyone else, not the singers, poemtry or some players. My idols are my older sisters, Albee and Jessica. Both of them have some talents that makes me so proud of them.
The first idol of mine is Albee. She didn't have nice temper before, so we didn't get well at that time. But she's English is pretty good. She often speaks English to me but usually I can't understand what she said. Because that, I was interested in English and learned English when I was 10.
The other idol is Jessica. She has a talent in Art. Since she become a freshman of university, she has more and more oppunity to show her talent. She often brings her works back home. She always tells me how difficult to finish this spectacular work. Though I don't understand details that she said, but I know that Jessica is the best artist I have ever seen.
They both are my super idols. There are many advantages I have to learn from them. And they are my loved sisters.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My Favorite Idol
Where there are people, there will be our idols. Some people love their idols whose face is handsome or beautiful, some people love their idols with particular skills. As for me, good-looks and skills are not the most important. On the contrary, I love someone who has a warm-heart.
My favorite idol is my uncle. He is tall and a little fat. Not only he is very humor but also he always has smile on his face. As long as chatting with him, my mood will become relax and pleasure. The most important thing is that he never regard me as only a child. Our relationship is like two intimate friends. Othewise, his warm-heart also teach me many rules about life. In my heart, he is not my favorite idol but also a person I love the most.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Van Tomiko who is a Japanese singer is my favorite idol. Van's voice is as peaceful as an angel. The songs she wrote lasted on the best-selling album for a long time as well. Sometimes, she appeared in public with long hair or curly hair. The major characteristics of her is passion. She is always vivid to her life. It seems that she has a dominant and strong personality to do everything. To present a good song to the fans, Van needs nothing but a great deal of information.
Without Van's songs, I couldn't make it through those difficult days. The lyrics of her songs cheer me up when I feel blue and bewildered. On the other hand, when I am tickled pink, I often listen to her songs to inspire me. As for me, Van is not only a idol, she is even like a friend. Her attitude toward learning has a great influence on me. I think that a person's success is owing to how they work hard and face to their challenge without being fear of.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is one of my friends, and he is also my classmate. He has talented in sports. He can play table tennis, basketball, soccer, and more. I like to watch him pratice takiwondo when the school is off. He loves takiwondo so much that I began to love it, too. He is also good at studying. He always gets the front place in our class on the midterm. And I always can't do as well as he does. Now the entrance exam of universty is on next year, I made a deal with him: We must be into the same universty in the future. My idol is a great example for me to inmate, and I want to be same with him. He is not only my idol but also my best friend.

subject: IW-0802
content:
The new generation goes on, more and more women have got more and more respection. In addition, more and more exhausting come to their mind.
There are many women not only work on day but also need to take care of their families at night. "How did they do it? Didn't they feel tired?" I thought to myself.
I have once asked a mother who has three little kids, "Did you feel tired? They are noisy! Even they are lovely, but they often bothers me!" "I don't think so. They are my children and I will give my whole love to them. Of course it is exhausting, but I feel happy." She said.
There are many beatiful models or perfect singers in Taiwan. Maybe there will be many teenagers take them as their idols. But mothers influence me much more. Everymother in this world is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I believe that everyone has a favorite idol. From Movie stars to scientists, everyone has a special characteristic or an awesome talent for people to admire. Of course I have a super idol in my mind, too. My idol is Joseph Smith, a prophet, and also the first presedent of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints.
I admire him because of his great faith to Heavenly Father and his diligent mind. The history of him and the church make me understand more about him. When he is 14 years old, he doesn't know which church is the real church of God. He pray for it, and he get the answear. He follows the holy spirit and he finds the golden lieves. He translates them into the Book of Mormon, which is another tastement of Jesus Christ. The Book of Mormon is on of the most importent book of the church. The process isn't very easy. Many people try to destroy the church and treat Joseph Smith and other saints very bad. But Joseph Smith never gives up. He has a pure heart and a simple faith. He suffers a great deal of pain but he never complains. Because of his insistence, the church is growing stronger from the 18th centery to now, and benefits over thousands of people all over the world.
Joseph Smith is a great example for me. I know I should always keep in faith through any hard time. I know that a man who stands for rights will always win. I like Joseph Smith also because of his strong tastemony of God wich encourages me a lot.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idols are nothing less than my parents.
My parents work very hard to raise my family. Although they are not wealthy and don't have high status, they are the greatest people in my mind. Through their behavior, I learn many things which I can't learn from books. But the most important of all, they love their children without wanting any repay. They do every things they can do for their children.
Father and mother, I want to say "Thank you."

subject: IW-0802
content: Ayumi Hamasaki is my favorite idol, and she is the best singer that I've ever seen. Why do I so crazy crush on her? It had to traced back to four years ago, I watched the music channel. And that the channel was showing on a program about Ayumi Hamasaki. At the first sight, I thought she was the most beautiful girl in the world. After listening her songs, I was crushed on her. Because of her magical voice and the lyrics of songs. All of the lyrics in her songs was writen by her, and every words knocked into my heart. Even the lyrics was writen in Japanese, but I still can understand what she wanted to talk. What a magical thing it is!

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has some favorite idols, and so do I. My idol is my classmate called Chris. Chris is a interesting guy who always makes everyone happy. He is not only a genius, but also a good teacher in many subject. Don't think he always studies in home, because he knows the idiom that is "All work and no play make Chris a dull boy". He is good at many sports, such as baseball, table tennis. If he just likes a perfect boy, I won't think of him as my idol. Because he has a good and kind mind, I think he is the only guy that can be my idol. If you have any idols, I will be very happy that you can share with me.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have an idol in their mind. There are may be not only their father, mother, older brothers and sisters but also some of popularities like singers, acters, athelectors and writers. I have an idol just like others. He is my favorite singer - Yoga Lin.

At the end of the game, Yoga was the champion. And I like him more than ever. He is the best singer in my mind. When I am not happy or get angry, I will listen to songs by Yoga, it makes me happy.
There are going to have a concert by Yoga on May, 2008. I wish that I can go to see him and let him know we are all his fans and we love him, because his my idol and always in my mind.

subject: IW-0802
content: My brother is my idol. Now he is studying in an university in America. When I was young, I liked to ask him some questions. subject: IW-0802
content:

The reason why I'm so appreciate him is that he plays basketball very well and has a good attitude when he is playing. He is alway the leader of a team. He isn't selfish. He shares the ball with his teamates. The most of all is that he always has a good attitude, pays attention to the game. He can scores and gets the rebonds. He always does his best when he is playing the game. I'm so appreciate him. Kevin Garnett is my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everybody has his own super idol, it included many kind of people like movie star, singer or other special person, but my favorite idol is my mother that she is a super women.
My mom is a police officer and she is a good mother either. No matter what happened outside, she always think to me in the first time, and no matter what the decision I made, she always support me, even I fall in the end, she always encouraged me to do more effort next time.
Everybody has his own idol and my idol is my mom who take care of me and give a right way when I lose my way. My mom is my favorite idol.

content: My idol is my father. My father has small eyes, short hair and a big mouth. Although he doesn't have good face, he has a smart brain. I repect him for three reasons. First, he is good at cooking. He can cook a big meal in ten minutes. Second, he has many friends. Because he is kind and patience to people. Besides, he is a teacher. I can learn a lot from him. He is my idol. I love him so much. Not just for he is my dad but for his good personality.

content:

He lives in China. We all knew China has many people, but the young man could feat other people and win many wards.
Why did I like him? Except his books and novels were very good, the other reason was he realizes what he will do. As he in my age, he publiced his first novel and he became a famous boy. After two years, he founded he didn't only want to write so he founded his book company and earned many money.
He tought me the we must know what things we wanted to do. This is a important event. I must realizes myself and knew what I wanted to do. If one person didn't realize these things, he would not to get success.

subject: IW-0802
content:

When I first knew that Beethoven couldn't hear, I was so shocked that I couldn't believe it! How can one continue to compose music without the ears? It is nearly impossible! However, Beethoven did it. I have always believed that it was the strong enthusiasm of music and the great desire of composing that lit the road of Beethoven. He worked very hard and buried himself in music. As a result, his music became so famous that even now his music was played by many people.

subject: IW-0802
content:

When it comes to saying something about them, I will be very enthusiastic because I regarded them as my rold model.

They have many part for us to learn, such as their ambitious to make their dreams come true and they are never give up easily. What a great group they are.
All in all, they will be my super idol forever and they are my mental teacher.

content:

subject: IW-0802
content: His fans are screaming and shouting not only in Taiwan but also in Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and many countries. The concert was filled with all of his fans, they wanted to join his concert in 2006 in Taipei. He is the best and well-known pop star of all the world. He's Li-Hong Wang. Though most of his relatives are doctors, his father and brothers are all doctors, Wang still decide to work in music. His latest album "Chang me" has sold more than one millions on its first day. I admire him because he is very talented and he knew well what his dream is and just never gave up. What's next for Wang? For this talented idol, his future is never a problem.

content:

She is very kind and patient for all students, when we can't understand the meanings of book, sentences, she always try her best to let us know.
Besides teaching English, she often cares our studying situation and afraids some of us can't figure out.
Because of her hard working, I was interested in English. Moreover, I learn how to use English for daily life.
Even now, I still miss her very much.
I have learned English more than ten years.
I find English is a useful language for connecting all around the world.
The most important of all, I can learn English well, it depend on my junior high school teacher. To sum up, she is a meaningful person of my life than any idols.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has his own idols such as famous modoles, athletes or artists. For me, my favorite idol is a movie star plays lots of important role in several movies. He is a handsome, friendly and muscular man in Korea. We can see him anywhere and anytime. For example, magazines are the best books for me to hear from him what he do next time. Besides, I can watch his performance by the TV. He joins many programs to broad his mind and horizon.
I am too addicted to this super star. Because of him, I damage my discipline sometimes, including the final exam was coming; I went to Taipei to see him when he came to Taiwan for the latest movie. There is no denying that he plays indispensable role in my daily life. The reason why I like him so much, he is good at drawing pictures. The other dream he want is to be a wonderful draw teacher for education instead of being a national surper idol all of the world.
With his best positive means, I'd like to run after him and being an artist also. I will do my best to let my dream come true.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idols
Everyone has an idol, and so do I. There are two idols in my life, one is my mother and another is a baseball pitcher, Wang. My mother is the most important person in my whole life. She devoted all her life for my family. When I was a child, my mother was a housewife. She cooked meals for us and what she cooked were delicious. She often teaches me and my sister the ethics. In addition, when I am in a bad mood, my mother always listens to my sorrows and cheers me up. Now, my mother is a career woman and busy with her occupation. Although we're both busy, we still have a good relationship.
My another idol is Chien-Ming Wang. He plays baseball in New York Yankees. I think he is admired since he makes great efforts to stay in the Major League Baseball. What's more, he has to practice on and on so that he can perform the best of him in the game. He is the pride of all people in Taiwan. To have an idol, we can regard them as our goals in life. To sum up, I hope I can view them as my models and follow their steps to succeed in years to come.

subject: IW-0802
content:
American idol
Two months ago, my family took me to American for a vacation in winter break, we stay there for three weeks, then I found out a famous show in there called "American idol." It is a show that everyone who likes to sing or good at sing can get in.
Jordon Sparkes, who won the champion in the show, is my idol. There has two reasons why I like her. First of all, she sings well and treat to people nice as well, when she sings the song "This Is My Now", my heart was be touched. How a brave girl she is! Secondly, she is a coy girl, no completed relationships on the television. When the famous people went to party for relaxsation, she chose working harder, that is why I like her very much.
Base on the reasons that I just mention, my favorite idol is Jordon Sparkes, who singing well and working hard in the show - American idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is Jolin. It is because her voice is so wonderful. Her songs are popular with young people. Most of Taiwan's young people like her. She dance very well. Many people learn her singing and dacing. She always do her best on the show. Recently, Jolin has song with Kelimiro (). Now the whole world know her. Jolin always challenges herself. She wants herself staying the best condition. So she works hard to sing and dance. She even go abroad to learn singing and dancing. I think Jolin is very beatiful and work hard. I will learn attitude from her.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their idol, and me too. The idol whome I like most is Jay Chou, the most popular singer in Taiwan. Many people like Jay Chou, too. His songs are beautiful and his handsome. The girls of my friends always wish that they can marry him. Besides, he can do many things by himself. For example, he can write many beatiful songs by himself. Also, he can play the piano well. I like to play the piano, too. That is the reason why I like Jay Chou most. My families didn't like him before because they thought that his music were too noisy. But now, they change their mind because of Jay Chou's movie coming out recently. Nowadays, my families always listen to Jay Chou's music with me. We always talk about Jay Chou. Without a doubt, Jay Chou has been our idol. That is, he will be in our minds forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I have always admired Michel Jordan because he can play basketball so well. But it's not the main reason. What impresses me the most is his personality.
When Jordan was a boy, his basketball skill was very poor. So when his teammates were whizzing on the basketball court, he often had to sit on the bench throughout the whole game. What's worse, his teammates didn't sympathize with him but made fun of him. But Jordan would not give up so easily. He then made it a plan to go to the basketball court first and leave latest. With so many days of practing, his efforts finally paid off when he helped his team gain a lot of scores in one game. Since then, he has become a well-known basketball player.
So that's the main reason why I admire him. Though he has retired, I will always remember the sprit which he kept in his harshest time.

subject: IW-0802
content:
You may call him my idol or say he is my God. He is the king of the golf world, Tiger Woods. He is so outstanding since childhood, and improves his skills and power every minute, without ending. That's why he ranks no 1 in the field for so many years.
He drives his ball into the sky like rocky, staying just on the middle of the fairway. He pulls his irons from his bag, watches concentratingly the greens and impacts the ball perfectly, rolling the hole straightly.
He plays golf so tremendous that other contendents fear to compete with him.
I believe he will remain the top-gun for a ling time.

subject: IW-0802
content:
It goes without saying that Jay-chou is the most famous idol in Taiwan. Thousands of boys and girl are fan to his musics and movies. His songs, clothes, style is copied by people, where he goes, the fans is there.
I love Jay-chou too. For the reason of his talent in establishment field. He has written many popular songs, every body crazy for them. Besides, he be an actor in many movies, got a good valuable.
In my opinion, alought Jay-Chou is a young man. He perform his art talent and do his best is what the reason I love him. At the meantime, my family are all love to listening his songs.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Somebody like their idols because they are beautiful or handsome. Others like their idols because they sing well. My favorite idol, Jolin, is a singer not only has beautiful face but also sings very well.
Jolin is an attractive singer. Since I was twelve years old, I have noticed her on TV. She caught my eyes by her powerful voice.
The most important reason why I like her is because of her hard working. When Jolin was about eighteen year's old, she can't dance at all! The dancing teacher even told her "You should try another work, not dancing." Although her teacher didn't think she will successful, she doesn't give up. She practice and practice. Finally, she did it! Jolin become famous, but she still works hard.
As a proverb says "A hard-working woman is the most beautiful woman." I think Jolin is the most beautiful woman in my heart.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is my dad. He is a wonderful father. He alway tells me that something I don't understand or something I haven't knowen. When I feel down, he always talks with me, and try to let me feel better. Also, he is a kind-hearted person. He like to help other people who in need, and that's why I like to help people too. Dad likes to tell me some news about environment or some news about movies, music or something I intersted in. I alway tell him what I do in the school. We are father and daughter, but sometimes we can talk with just like friend, and that's why my dad always close to me. To me, he isn't just a father or a friend, he is the idol of mine forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol have never change since I was child, he always be nice to me, when I caught a cold, he will take care of me. In my childhood, he was my best teacher, taught me math, English......, he is father. I am so happy that I have a such kind of father. If I do something wrong, he spend many time telling what is right and what is good for me. I learned so many things on him. I was remember that, one times I was fail in a big test. and I got home with badlooking face. My father of course notice that, he came to my room and told me softely: "Don't be sad like this. I believe that you will be better next time." his word encourage me so much, from then, every time I taking test, I will do my best to answer the question and try to not let my Dad disapoint again.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is my English teacher, Mr. Lee. He is middle age but he is very active. He has a big eyes and as tall as Chang-Ming Wang.
I admire his teaching skill, attitude, and he also is my mental teacher. He always use some picture to help me learn vocabulary. Sometimes, he used some cookies as a gift when I had a good grade on the test. Out of school, he is my best friend. He always gave me many good advise when I had problems.
I'd like to be as Mr. Lee. I had learn form him not only knowlegue but also some basic attitude. He abundant my life. I'll study harder and remember all he told me in mind. Because he is my favorite idol, Mr. Lee.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has their own idol, and their idol may be a famous singer, an attractive movie star or some else.
My idol is the person who gave me my life - that is my mother. Since I was born, she has taken care of me for almost 15 years, and never complained. First of all, she would do anything for me and doesn't want me to do anything for her in return. In addition, when everytime I got sick, she would always be with me and take care of me. She would take me to see the doctor, and ask for advice nervously. Last but not least, she gives me love. She would always let me feel love around me, and that feeling is very good. My mother is just like a superman, and she can do anything. On account of these reasons, my mother is really my super idol!

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have idols who may a sporter, a writer, a singer or a man around you. I am no exception. I also have idols whose name is Jolin. She is a famous singer. She is not only good at singing but also good at dancing. She is humanity on everything. She want to do her best on ever things. And the most important above all, she is good at English. For celeberty, good at English seems a difficult things. Thus, I like her. She also be a model I want to mimic. Because I want to have ability to speak flent English someday. So, I like her not just she is a pretty woman, but a working hard woman.

subject: IW-0802
content: "What kinds of idol do you like?" many people always ask me, and it seems to be like a easy question the idol which I most like is Jay Chou. how to say I like him, the songs he writes are always be listened to on stress corner, so everyone can sing his songs easily, also he is very intelligent in everying he done, he can make it better and richer. Though many adults don't like him at all, I still believe that he is the best idol who I like.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol now is Japanese singer named w-inds. It is a three-people group, one main singer and two dancers. I very like to listen to their music. When I am sad, listening their songs can let me feel happy and do anything better. Their dance is another one point. It let me like to dance and be more healthy. Although I do not understand their langurage, I could understand the message what they want to send to fans in the songs. After several years passing, I think I will also like them as now!

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people always have an idol or more in their heart. Someone' idols are sportmen and someone' idols are artists, the other's are movie stars. Believe or not believe it, I will say, my father is my idol forever.
When I was born, my family was in poor condition. Unfortunately, my father faced a first challenge, my father's factory was burn, and on this time, my father had to rebuild the factory, and grew up me, so he had a lot of pressure, but he never felt sad, he always said critis is opportunity. I very love his nature of life. After the first challenge, the economic condition was better and better.
Unfortunately the second trouble was coming. One day, when my father was working in his log factory, suddenly, one large log falled on my father's left leg, and in the scene, his left leg was broken, and soon went to hospital, at this time, my family loses the source of money, and the economic condition was bad again.
After my father went out the hospital, he actively made his business better and better. In order to make his dream true, he worked over ten hours per a day in my childhood. Although he is too busy to look after me, I never hate him, and I love him very much. Nowaday, he becomes a perfect businessman in society, in the other word, he is a famous person on business guard. I am very proud of him, and one day I want to become person like him. His word, "Never give up" always in my mind. My father is my idol, my teacher, my friend.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my mother. She is a good cook. Since I was born, she took care of me. She talk to me about the process what born me. She spent two days then I was born. That is a very difficult thing. I love her very much. And she can made clothes. When my pants was too long, she can made it to suit me. It was a magic for me. Another way, she is kind. Her speak was softly. That let me confortable and I want to listen to her. She taught me to treat people well. People should help each other. I agreed with her opinion. I tried do my best to do anything that is for her. She influented me very much. She is my idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
I think I have many idols, like Andy Roddick and Roger Federer. But one of them, the most important one, is my brother. He is not in Taiwan now. He goes to Spain for looking job. Before he went to Spain, he taught me many things, not only the knowledge about school and Taiwan, but also the thinking of world. He is always rich, but not having many money, insteadly, he knows many things.
Because of my brother, I have some changes. I was lazy before I didn't know the world, but I am busy after I see the world. I understand many things about future because my brother told me what will the world be.
In future, if I can be rich, I have to thank my brother. Without him, I am nothing. Because of him, I am something.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is the person who live with me, and everyday I can see him at the morning. That is my father, the person who take care of me when I was little. He works outside to suport the family and teach us how to be a person everybody like. He has said "To be patient at everytime", and all of us followed it. I'm proud of my father, he always put us at the first place, however, he has a lot of work to do, that was why I love him.
He is the most important person in my life, because of him, I can study at the school and even learn to be a man like him. He has a strong arm to keep away the dangerous, and love us by his true heart. What is idol? The person who love you so much like your Dad is your idol. I love you, Dad.

subject: IW-0802
content:
As everyone knows, Chen Ming Wang is a very good baseball player in the Major League Baseball. He is Taiwan hero, and he is my idol, too.
Generally speaking, Chen Ming Wang is very quiet. In the other hand, his English is not very good. But when he is a pitcher, he can concentrate on the ball in his hand, and face any player.
Everytime, he finished a perfect baseball game. Media ask him "How do you feel?" He always says "I just do it." He never show off. Because of it, Chen Ming Wang was my favorite pitcher. I learned to face any problem in a calm, amd attitud is very important. He is not only a good pitcher, but my teacher. No one can deny, do your best! Anything will be perfect!

subject: IW-0802
content:
Most of people in Taiwan like baseball games, from teenagers to the adults, boys to girls, men to women. When there is international ball games, we can see a lot of fans to go to the field to watch the game.
To mention about the baseball in Taiwan, everyone will think about Chien-Ming Wang. Although he plays baseball in the U.S. Major League, I still like him very much. Every time when he steps on the pitcher's plate, he can control the whole situation in short time and leads the teams to win the game.
Not only the professional performance C. M.Wang has, but also his charming characteristic that makes everybody loves him. He always say that it's team work to win after the game. Besides, his lovely smile grabe a lot of female fans heart!
Chien-Ming Wang is my favorite baseball player in the world.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people may have their own idol. In addition to famous actors, athlestics or writers it might be some people around you. As me, I'm so proud of my dad and he is my idol. I'm so happy that I have this kind of father. He always helps me whenever I have problems and always cheers me up when I am down. He is just like my best friend. We also play basketball or hike together on weekends. He is not only a good father, but a good boss in the company. He is nice to every employees and even usually buys some snacks for them in the afternoon. By doing so, all the employees love him much and do well at work. My dad is the most polite and sweet person that I have ever met. I'm proud of him and love him so much. I also wish that I can be a person as good as him.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Vanness Wu. He is a special singer. I adore him not because of his appearance but his attitude toward the work. Not only can he sing a good song, but he can also perform an amazing dance. Vanness devote himself into his career, even though it might make him lose some freedom and privacy. In the beginning of his job, he faced a lot of difficulty such as critics on his performance. All this debate might make a person lose self-confidence. But he never give up the dream of becoming a good singer. With the support of his family, he tried again and again. He tried to prove that he is a talented singer instead of a handsome model. In my opinion, a person with positive attitude will make him attractive. So I regard Vanness Wu as my idol and try to become as brave as he is.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Almost everybody has his or her idol, and so do I. During my past sixteen-year life, I have been influenced a lot by my idol, who is my mother.
Whenever I tell my friends whom I worship the best, I am always laughed and looked incredibly at. They can not understand why a teenager's idol is not a famous singer or a notable actor or actress, but is my mother instead. However, of course, I have my own reasons of choosing Mom as my idol. First of all, she is a diligent woman. She has done her best to take care of the home all the time over the last 20 years. Second, she is really gentle and sensible. If I did something wrong or stupid, she would just tell me what I should do next time and never shout at me. Moreover, my mother always wears a smile on her face and so that anybody will like her at the first sight.
To me, Mother is the person who has indeed impacted on me very much. Mabey it will make myself look like a dependent child in my friend's eyes; nevertheless, if somebody asks me who my idol is. "It's my mother!" I will still answer loudly and clearly. "She is the one that I want to be like in the future."

subject: IW-0802
content:
I have a favorite writer, he is my idol who is called Giddens.
Giddens first is a international writer, but now he is famous. And his writing type is variable. In his books, I like the "Killer" best. In Killer, it always says people's devil, dark, and ugly. One man may be killed because someone is boring. In Killer, the killer also have many types, someone is humurous, someone love to eat candies, and someone love to play computer games,...etc. Giddens seems want to tell us, killers are not devil, they are innoance, "Killer" is just their job, they just do theirselves, The devil is humon's heart, they want money, they want power, they want everything in the world. I think that "Killer" is worth to read. By reading this book, I was deeply convinced that this world is not so wonderful I have ever thought.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their own idols. When it comes to the idol, I will think of Chen-Ming Wang.
Chen-Ming Wang is a baseball player. He is a pitcher in MLB now.
There are three reasons why I like him very much. First, he's very hard-working. He thinks it's the best way of becoming better and better. Second, he isn't proud. Though he's so famous that many people know him, he learns every thing carefully. Finally, he always helps people who are in need. For example, he donated a lot of money to help children who don't have enough money to set up a baseball team in Taiwan. I think that is very good to help others.
Chen-Ming Wang is such a nice person that I respect him very much. I can learn many things from him. He's a good role modol.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is my best friend, Alex, because I think he is the kindest person in the world. Alex has big eyes, straight hair, and he loves to help people all the time. Remember one time, Alex saw an old man hurt by his legs beside the road, but no one saw it. Although Alex was almost late for school, he took the old man to the hospital. After this, I thought he was an angel from the heaven.
Alex is also good at math. He always gets an 100 at the math test and he always teaches everyone. I think Alex is really a good person because he is never mad at anyone he doesn't like. He just help people everytime even though he never met them.
Because of Alex's good deeds, he is really an idol of mine. I hope we can be good friends for ever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is Jolin. At first I didn't like her at all. I didn't think her dance was good and her voice was attractive. After released three album she faded out, because of the contact.
To everybody's surprise, two years later Jolin became like the other person. Her baby fat is gone and bosom is bigger the before. Some reporters and magazines said that Jolin had an operation about her face and body. But I don't care about this, the most important is she really improve very much. Her dance is fabulous. Many students join the dance club in school just because they want learn Jolin's dance. Her songs also hit the market and hot in youngsters.
I once watched a conversation show about Jolin on TV. She said "I work hard because I don't want to lose". To keep slim, she can eat boiled food only. It's hard to me.
I like Jolin's attitude. She will try hard to do everything and never give up. She won the Best Singer at the Golden Melody Award in 2007. She is the best idol in my heart.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has a idol. I have one, too. He is my father. My father, a college teacher, has been a idol in my heart for a long time since I was little. He can solve all the question in our family, housework, cook, even my homework. Though he is a history teacher, he has a lot of knowledge. Chinese, English, biology and he also can speak French. He is a sixty-year-old man, but he still stay healthy. He goes jogging with my mother for at least one hour every morning. He is a kind person, too. He treats his students like his children. Go home for dinner, go out to play and talk things that I never hear for. Not only he is my best father, but he also is my idol in my heart.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite singer is Boa. In fact, she is my idol, too. Boa is a famous singer in Japan. Her voice is sweet and soft. In addition, I have many CDs of her. When I have free time, I always listen to them. It's always made me happy and relax to listen to her CDs. Sometimes, when she has a concert, I will be very excited. Even though I can't go to her concert, I still be happy. I can see her on TV. When someone wants me to share some great music for her, I always say that Boa's music is very good. Now, there is a new album of Boa's which is coming. I can't wait to buy it! I hope that I can go to her concert in the future. That will be the most important memorise in my life.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is "Ashely Tisdale" now. She is beautiful and her voice is so sweet. When I watch the movie "High School Musical" first time, Her character is "Sharpay". Although in the show, I didn't like her so much as now. But I found that she is very professional about acting and singing. After that, I went to the music store and look for her debut album. Finally, I found an album called "Headstrong" by Ashely Tisdale.
Every night, I listen to it again and again. Her voice is different to other singers. Especially, her high sounds are not too sharp. I really love her so much. If I have a chance, I would take an airplane to America just to listen to her concert.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everything in the world has its own two sides, Without exception, my favorite idol is Jay Chou, who was a famous singer in Taiwan. Perhaps, he has both advantage and disadvantage. As far as I am concerned, his advantage outweights his disadvantage. There are numerous reasons why I hold the opinion and I would explore a few of the most important ones as follows.
The major reason that be seen by everyone is that his experience of his invention. I believe that by his talent, there are many songs in the market which he made it. For example, the song "the beautiful new world" by S.H.E is one of his inventions.
Another factor we must consider is that he is the first singer owning many personal concerts in the world. It inspirts me to be a famous singer.
On the whole, if we take a carefully consideration, it isn't difficult to make a conclusion that why I like him so much.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is my father, who is always busy on his work. When I was an elementary school student, my father left home for his work. He was seldom at home with us. But it doesn't mean that he didn't care about his family. Every month when he came home, he always took us for a trip so that everyone could get relax. Besides, he also talked a lot with me in order to make our relationship better.
I think he is the best father in the world. He not only worked hard to make money for us, but he took good care of us. I hope I could do what he does. He could spend time on both working and keeping company with his family. I am glad I have such a father.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol who has a long straight hair and big eyes is my classmate. Her name is Jane. She is one of my best friends. Jane also has good grades, so I always asked her some questions about the homework. Jane is beautiful, slender, and good EQ. Many boys in other classes wanted to know her. Although Jane has fans, she just be the person like others. I like her, because she always be a good listener when I had bad mood. I thought we will be best friends forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has an idol in their heart. Maybe it's an artist, or and athlete or just someone near you. I have an idol, too. He is my father.
I like him so much, and I'm really proud to have a father like this. He is a man that whenever he made a promise, and he will really do it; and he is just like a library, he knows everything that you want to know or you don't know. He never gives up doing anything, such as finishing an essay, but at the sametime, teaching my brother doing his homework and cooked dinner for me. Maybe some people will say that doing lots of things at the same time is not good, but just imagine it, isn't that like a real superman? Though my father is not a comany's manager or a busy businessman, but he always work hard, and this is why I like him so much, not just a father or an idol, and a person that I'd like to be when I grow up.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Many people have their idol, and so do I. I have many idol, but my favorite idol is a singer. She is a superstar in Taiwan, and she is A-mei.
A-mei is the greatest singer in my mind. Why I love her so much? Because she has a powerful and excellent voice and she is also very beautiful. She treats her fans very well and her songs are good to listen to. Not only in Taiwan, She is also famous in China, Hong Kong, Japan and in the U.S.A. She is loved and respected by many people, and many people like to sing her songs, but her songs are difficult to sing, so it shows that she is very wonderful. She is the pride of Taiwan. I love her very much.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is BoA who is a singer comes from Korea. She also can speaks Japanese and English. BoA started to be a singer when she was 13 years old. She was so young that many people didn't think she could succeed at first. BoA didn't give up to be a singer. She practiced singing and dancing everyday. Finally, she was successful. She can sings and dances well and has a lot of fans. Now BoA is a famous singer in Asia. When BoA had trouble, she didn't give up. She did her best and worked hard on everything. Somebody who didn't like her before are very surprised at her now. That's why I love BoA so much.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has his favorite idol, but it different from person to person. It may be a singer, an author, a musician, and even the people just around us.
I think everyone can be my idol, because I could learn something from each of them. But I consider I like the nature most, it is my idol. It taught me all the things, included how to speaking, how to listening, how to drawing, and so on, whichever you can name it.
What is more, as you clam down, you will found out that the best teacher is the nature. Every day it taught you a different lesson. So it is not only my idol but also my techer.

content: When I was young I was very approative who can create song by oneself. And now is the same. Why do I think that? Because I think it is need to creative and ingenious. All of she song was created by herself also the sing. I like her song very much. Each of her CD was very hot and hit. Every year of Japaneses New Year has a famous program is Red-White competion. But she is been appear for 14 years. By this reason you can understand one thing that is how much she hot! And this is why I love her so much.

subject: IW-0802
content:

I think that he really got a good voice. He often gives me some advises in music, and I really learn much about that from him. And he also knows many good songs. Because he is older than me, he always talks to me about my life, my thoughts, and my schoolwork; in other words, he just like a teacher in my life.
I usually got some spacil experiments from him, such as helping him in his band's performance. I think that it is wonderful to be one of his friends.

subject: IW-0802
content:
A lot of people are addicted to their idols. They can be writers or baseball players. Even they can be somebody around you. I have my favorite idol, too.
First, his name is Daniel Vosovic, which is the designer of the program called Project Runway. I admire him because he is not only talented, but also humble. Many designers in the competition are so ambitious that they always mean to others, such as, they speak foul language. However, Daniel is polite to other opponents. He believes that everyone is very overwhelming, so he has to respect them.
Second, he is a great co-worker. When they have to work in groups, he is a popular teammate that everyone wants to be in his team. I think that his good personality lead him to achieve.
Moreover, he won the competition although he is not the first place. Many reporters asked him how to be successful. He said that he just respects everyone.
In all, I think he is my idol. Not only being excellect at work, but also at the relationship.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is who I most love and I think is most beautiful woman excatly my mother. Why my idol is my mother? Becaus I think she always hard-working on her business and housework, but she never complain us about that, she just do her best on all of her works and take good care of my sister and I.
I want to become a woman like my mother as soft as her heart and treat anybody with kind.

subject: IW-0802
content:
Everyone has an idol. Whether he or she is a celebraity an athlete, a writer or even one of your friends.
My idol is my friend, Shine. She is an ABC. She used to live in Canada and now she goes back there every summer vacation and winter vacation. I think she must be the coolest person on earth. She can does everything you can imagine. She can speaks both English and Chinese well and a few French. She plays many kinds of sports, such as tennis, soccer, basketball and volleyball.
Shine is also a musician, she can plays the piano and the drums. Shine even can write a song by herself.
Shine has a good personality. She always thinking of others. At last, I love her very much and she is going to be my best friend from now and then.

subject: IW-0802
content: I think everybody has idol, me too. Your idol can be writer, singer, athlete, your teacher also your parents. I have idol since I was 10, maybe more young, Who's my idol? My idols is very special! Their style is punk, rock and visual. My idol always dress very colorful or dark. They can makeup but they're boys, must be boys. Visual idol have no girls. But maybe you'll be confused " why do I see the girl some times?" . I'll tell you "They're all boys! It won't have exception." They're very special. I think many people don't like them. Like some of my friends, they think visual idol are strang, weird and sissy. It make me angry and sad... But I'll keep supporting them regardless of my friends criticizing. They are very cool, really gorgeous! One day if they disappear, I will go to die! Ah, just kidding, I'll bored to die!! My life would lose something can make me happy when I'm unhappy. Maybe it's not serious like what I say. But they are impotant. Part of my life. Part of myself. How about your idol??

subject: IW-0802
content:
I have a super idol in my mind. I think is my mom. My mom is a single parents, she took me up by herself.
She didn't has a high degree, so she just can do a part-time job. She works very hard, but she didn't complane anything.
She usually tell me and my brother to study hard, and I try my best to do it. I want to earn much money, let her live in a big house.
I love the life attuide from my mom, I want to be a women like her when I grow up.
Although I usually argure with her, but I love her very much. She is my super idol forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My favorite idol is comic writer. I don't know her real name; instead, I know her nickname. Her name is Wan-wan. As a comic writer, she has to find some material from life. She was an office lady, who always stayed in office to deal with documents. However, she likes to draw on the book. On account of a chance, she republished her first book, a comic book, which made many people in Taiwan know her.
I don't think that all kind of her books are filled with unusual, odd and imagenative elements. In fact, those stories which she describes are so ordinary that we can find them in our lives. Sometimes we consider it not a big deal. We even have no interest to take note of these chores. Nevertheless, these stories become more different than they were when the writer describes them and turned them into comic. Suddenly, they are not so boring. Besides, they are always full of humor. Her book can relieve us, releasing our stress. Every time I read her book, I found that I can be more happy and optimisstic if I want. What a good writer!

subject: IW-0802
content:
Most of my favorite singers are from Korea. There are many handsome and powerful man, who are in the big group.
I like them when their album first came out in Taiwan, I heard their wonderful voice then I really love it.
Moreover, I like Taiwanese actors, they are so charming that I can't stand watching them many time a day.
I know every singers or actors are really great, because they will try to do their best when the performance is coming. But nowdays so many people like to download the songs from Internet and copy in CDs, I awfully hate their behavior.
We should support our favorite singer all the time don't just say love them and download their songs.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My Favorite Idol
Almost everyone has his or her own idol, and so do I. My father is my idol. In my mind, he is a superman who can cope with everything. Our family is dependent on him. Due to his competence and diligence, we all love him very much. Some of his merits are described as follows. First, he is adept at repairing house appliances when those things do not work. Second, my father is a love-and-take-care-of-family man who is always kind to us. Third, he is of great ambition and determination. He trys his best to succeed in his occupation. We all love Father; he is our superman. No one is more important than my father. Father, I love you!

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is my mother. She loves me and helps me when I am in need. She is beautiful and considerate. When I was a baby, she hug me all the time. She is kind to me and she always has a smile on her face. She is my idol because she can do everything. She is a superwoman and she never feels tired. She likes to go hiking and mountain climbing with me, my brother and my father. She cooks well. I love every food cooked by her. She is a wonderful person. I am glad that I have a perfect mother. I think that she is the best idol in my life and I respect her forever.

subject: IW-0802
content:
My idol is my mother. She is a person who always never give up for everything she want to do. She is not only a good wife but also a good mother. The reason why I think is that she has took care of my father for 13 years. My father is unable, because he had drunken driver. Unfortunately, he would be a person who should lain on the bed to live his left years. However, my mother never gave up, she found other hospitals to make my father better. Eventually, she found one, and my father can walk by himself now.
Even though that accident changed my family, my mother never complained about it, she accepted it and took care of my family well.

subject: IW-0802
content: When it comes to my idol, it's very unique. It's my father. He's not only a hard-working teacher at school, but also a good father for me. First, he sets a good example for me. He teaches us behavior is more important than schoolwork. No matter how great your schoolwork is, you can't be a good person without kind heart and good behavior. Morover, he usually helps me to solve my schoolwork problems. If he doesn't know the correct answer, he will search for it and teach me why the answer should be that. Above all, he loves the family. What he does is for my family. In short, he is my best idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: The idol that I like is such a beautiful girl. She is beauty and kindness. Her name is Lu-Yi-Fe. She has a wonderful voice. I like her songs very much. Not only her voice is great but also her performance is good. At first that I knew about her was on TV. The TV program is Tn-Lun-Pa-Bu which is her first time to perform. She played a second charactor in that program. When I saw her at that program first, I knew she is beautiful but I was not like her so much. When I saw her at another program, I started loving her. She is a professinal performer. Her perform-skilled is great so I love her very much.

subject: IW-0802
content: I have many idols in my mind like Jay, Edward, Roy. But my favorite idols are my parents. My parents are my idols forever. I was born in a poor family. My father worked as a taxi driver, and my mother took care of my brother and me at home. Sometimes my mother found a part-time job to pay the rent. My younger brother and I grew up in a hard life. I always saw my parents work hard to earn the money since my childhood. I hope I could help them, so I study very hard. I am thankful for my parents to take care of us. I want to earn much money to let they know I love them and repay they at all costs.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol are my parents. I love them because they help me a lot. For instance, When I was in junior high school, I had a lot of questions about my math. I knew my math was terrible. Math grades often discouraged my confidence. Whem my parents saw my test paper, their face was showing anxious and got a little angry. But they didn't yell at me. Instead of shouting to me, they encouraged me to work hard. Now, my grades of math is better than before. Thanks to my parents encouragement, I can get good grades. I want to be the idol of my children, this is the best way I can thank to my parents.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their own idol, and I am no exception, too. Kobe Bryant is my idol, he is a basketball star in Lakers. I like him since I was a child, and therefore, I tried to imitate him and practice how to play basketball. When I see him in the screen everytime, I always forget to do what I am going to do, I just keep watching him in the television.In the NBA, Kobe Bryant is a super star. He has a good basketball skill so he can get at least thirty points in the tournament and beat all of his opponent. He also break many records. These are why I like Kobe Bryant.

subject: IW-0802
content: I like S.H.E. They are the most famous group in Taiwan. When I was 12, I had heard their songs for the first time. Then, I searched their information on the Internet. After doing the action, I fell in love with their voice, their performance and their friendship. Now, I am really busy for my studies. But I still spend my time listening to their songs. I love them very much because they help me to pass the hard part of my life. They also teach me how to be a good person and do right things for others. They want to sing together until they are 80. I believe I will love them forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol was my father. He was a firefight who was fifty years old. He was a kind and hard working person but never neglect his family so we had a lot of time with him too. My father was a brave and kind-heart man. He always standed in the first line to save people's lives and do his best to help people who was locked in the basement or stuck in the fire. For example, our neighbor's house was blazed and their baby was stuck in it at the two o'clock a.m. and my father jumped out and rush in the bathroom when he hearded the sound near my house. He takes out a sheep with water and wear it to rush into the fired house. Finally he went out with the baby. At that time I saw my father's brave behavior and I wanted to be a firefighter with him after growing up. So he was my only idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their own idols such as actors, writers and singers. I have my favorite idol, too. His name is Jay. He is tall and thin. He also has gray hair and blue eyes. Jay is good at singing. He has a beautiful voice. Everytime when I hear his voice, I feel if I were in the heaven. Why do I like Jay? Because he is very handsome and always has a smile on his face. Jay is good at swimming, too. Last month, I read the newspaper and found that he won the swimming champion again, Jay is the most successful person in my mind. I think I would like to be a person like Jay in the future because I want to be as popular as him. I think that's the reason I do love Jay!

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone all has his or her favorite idol, I am no exception. My favorite idol is a player who plays basketball. But I can't remember his name now. I appreciate him because I prefer to do exercise. Looking my past, I always played basketball with my friends and climbed mountains with my family. By playing basketball, I can train my body and improve my health. More importantly, it is a good way to win one's harmonious human relations. By hiking mountains with my family, the scenery there enables me to relieve pressures from schoolwork. In this way, I can breathe fresh air and enjoy the beautiful scenery. There are a lot of advantages by doing exercise. This is one of the reasons why I love this player.

subject: IW-0802
content: My father has been my idol since I were a child. When I was a child, I regarded my father as a surperman. He could do many things and he was very brave. Once I fell into the river but I couldn't swim. I was very scared and cried loudly. When my father heard my voice, he jumped into the river and scured me. I found I can learn many things from my father when I get along with him. For example, when I face difficult things, I wouldn't give up easily, and I would try my best to do it. There were also some good personility I could learn from my father. He is honest, hardworking, and optimic.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is a writer who writes the novel book Holy Poter. I enjoy read novels and the Holy Poter is the most meaning that I have ever read. In her novels, I can find she is a imaginable, smart, irrational and justice person. Reading her novels can improve my creative skill, patient, wisdom and children heart. Indeed, she is a single mother that has to grow her children up by herself. Having a big heart, she donate some of her income to improve the poor person's life. Even though she has a good reputation, she is always presents humble and kind to everyone. In short, that is why many people admire her so much including me.

subject: IW-0802
content: Some like popular singers and others like famous athletes. But I like otherwise. My favorite idol is my mother who is the most beautiful woman that I like very much. There are many reasons why I like her. First of all, she gets up early and prepares breakfast for me every morning. Second, every night when I come home after school, she asks me if I am happy in school. And her consideration never fails to make me feel warm. Once in a while, I don't do well in the exams. She always encourages me to let me feel good and confident again. And I am grateful for what she has done for me. Also I hope I will be a good person so that my mother won't worry about me.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol, also my best friend, is Mike. I have known him since junior high school. When I was a student, I was very lonely. It seemed that no one wanted to talk or to play with me, of course, except Mike. He was an out-going boy. I could talk with him for more than one hour! He told me that I should be happy, or few people wanted to talk to me. Because of him, I became happier than before. He always liked to help people who were in trouble. That's why I like him so much. Now we don't live in the same city. But he is still my best friend and idol. I want to help people just like he helped me.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Lin Chi-Che. He is a basketball player who belongs to Taiwan Bear Team. He has a nickname "Beast" because his playing style is so wild. I think that I never forget that game. In that game, Lin Chi-Che gained forty-three points on himself. What a great player he was! However, Taiwan Bear Team lost. It was such a pity. In addition, one game Lin Chi-Che hurt his left leg, but he still finished that game. He said "even if I only have one leg, I still want to play the game. I never give up!" It is his attitude that I look up to so much. In my life, Lin Chi-Che is not only my idol but also my teacher. I learn attitude and perseverance from him. To me, the game is not only the game. It is a lesson in every game.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their idols. They might be movie stars, sportsmen or writers. But until I have a faith in God, Jesus is the only one who I consider the perfect now. From the Bible, I can learn that he is truly loving, wise and brave. These characterisms are what I am eager to have. Moreover, when I am down, He raises me up through many forms, such as a story, a thought or a verse on the Bible. He is the person that I want to be. Though there is sorrow, He will turn it into happy tears as a lesson for me. Being grateful is always my attitude toward Him. The way to express my gratitude is to be like Him. He is my idol, and it can't be overestimated too much.

subject: IW-0802
content: The greatest idol in my mind, without a doubt, is my mother. She is an old lady who is almost fifty years old but still enthusiastic in studying. In fact, she has studied medicine in China since last year. What a hard work it was! Especially for her. She doesn't have good health because of working too much the past years. It seemed that the bodie's problem didn't break her dream at all. Though we need to separate for six years, I'm still glad that she found out her goal. My families are proud of her brave, also we really missed her.

subject: IW-0802
content: I love my Chinese teacher, Ms. Lin who is kind and outgoing. She treats everyone as equal although you didn't get good grades on your Chinese tests. Ms. Lin takes good care of all of her students. You may ask help of her if you don't feel better. She will give you some medicine. She always helps me to solve all the questions in my books after school. She works hard and takes lots of notes to her lovely students. Ms. Lin teaches us all the knowledges what she learned before. All I need to do is listen very very carefully and behave myself in class. She's the most greatest Chinese teacher I have even seen. I wish I could enter the same college which Ms. Lin study in. She is just too wonderful to let me respect her.Ms. Lin who is my Chinese teacher is my super diva.

subject: IW-0802
content: When I was young, my father was my idol, he had short hair, a strong body, low voice and most of all, a kind heart. I thought my father was a superman, because he could do lots of housework after a tiring day, even played games with me, he was alway energetic.My father is not only a teacher but also a good listener. I could tell him any secret, and turned to him for help when I was in trouble. He was such a good father. After so many years, I still suppose that my father is my super idol and forever.

subject: IW-0802
content: Lots of people have their favorite idols. Besides movie stars, atheles, writters, the person also can be who surrounding you. My favorite idol is a basketball player. His name is Sean Chen. He is very handsome, very tall and his basketball skill also very great. I like to play basketball very much. Though I am a girl, but I think my basketball skill is better than some boys. Sean is very gentle and funny, for example, if his fans want to take a photo with him, he musn't say no! Sometimes he also makes a funny facial expression to let his fans feel release. So I hope one day I can play basketball as well as him and be a gentle person.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has their idol, someone like movie stars and somebody love sport stars, but for me, my favorite idol is my dad. My dad was born in a poor family, so he had worked in a factory since he was eight years old. He was studied hard and worked hard, because he wanted to change his life by himself. When he was sixteen years old, he decided to quit the study so that he could earn more money to buy a house to his parents. On his twenty years old birthday, he gave my grandparents a house. Nobody believed that he was do it. His hard working is the best lesson for me. I want to do my best to follow his steps.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have idols, like stars, players and even writers can be your idol. Today, I want to talk about my special idol, my Dad. I can't remember when I start admiring my father. Since I have memory, my father has taken care of me and my family with his loving hand. Even Dad is busy, he does his best to prevent me and my sister from hurt. He always tells me to wear more clothes when it is cold. He also brings umbrella to me when it rains outside. Even sometimes, his careless really annoys me and I yell at him. He is never angry with me, and tells me what he does is because he loves me. I sees my Dad as my idol not because he has power or he makes a lot of money, but his love for us. Thank you, Dad. You are always my super idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: Most people have idols. Of course, I have a idol, too. He is Kevin Martin, an NBA player. He plays basketball on the Kings. I admire him so much that I don't miss any game which he appeared. "You are a girl! Why do you like to watch basketball games?" A lot of people asked me. In fact, I really don't know why I love basketball so much! I enjoy playing basketball and watching basketball games! Cheering for my favorite player is my habit. When the first time I saw Kevin Martin, he caught my eye! Although he is shorter than other players, he still plays basketball very well. He never gives up until the last second! I was touched by his spirit! He has become my favorite NBA player since he won that game which I saw him first time. When I get into trouble, I always come up with his spirit "If you want to be successful, try your best until the last second! Never give up any opportunity!" This is why I love him so much, and I will keep cheering for my favorite basketball player - Kevin Martin.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has his own idol, and I am not exception. My idol is my chemistry teacher. She taught me when I was in the second years of high school. She often used many tools to let me understand how two materials worked when they were put together. In addition, she really arranged classmates to do experiments. Though I didn't have much interest in chemistry, she still inspired me with a love to this subject. Whenever I had problems about it I would turn to her to solve my confusion. Thus, I was getting more and more interested in chemistry. Thanks to chemistry teacher's help, I scored high in a final exam. This made me feel more confident in this subject. And I was so proud of myself! In the future, I'd like to major in chemistry, and want to learn advanced course. If I am really admitted to ideal college, I will credit this to my teacher!

subject: IW-0802
content: Frankly speaking, my idol is not a very famous person and he is not very rich, either. Actually, the person that I praise is my English teacher in the cram school, David.When I was young, I hated English so much because it was quite hard for me to memorize all the English words. Due to that reason, I decided to give up learning English. So my English was pretty bad when I was little.After he appeared in my life, I began to change my mind. Because he made learning English be interesting and made me realize that learning English is not difficult at all.Though he is quite young now, he really teaches good English.The reason I like him is that he often tells hilarious jokes and always makes us fun. Moreover, he has a good temper that he seldom gets angry. He is really kind to students and always treat us. So every student in the cram school likes him very much. He is a person that I want to be in the future.So I am compelled to say that he is the most perfect person in the world!

subject: IW-0802
content: People always have their idols. No matter their idols are movie stars, famous athletes or authors, people learn things from their idols and follow their paces. My idol is Coco Lee, my homeroom teacher. He is a friendly old man and cares his students a lot. He constantly emphasizes the importance of studying. In his mind, studying is the fastest way to be a useful person, so he always forces us to read more books. Although he is very strict, I still think he is doing the right thing for us. I will follow what he says and be a useful person in the future. I hope I could be as successful as my idol is.

subject: IW-0802
content: I like to play basketball, so I often watch NBA games. Through watching these games, I learn many basketball skills, and make a great improvement. Among these top basketball players, I like Kobe Bryant most. Kobe Bryant is the super star in his team, Los Angle Laker. He joined the team ten years ago, and now he is twenty-nine-year-old. He has the best skills in National Basketball Association. No one can prevent him from getting much more points. This is why I like him very much, but the most reason why I like him is his great change. In the early period of Kobe's career life, he was very selfish. He just paid attention to get more and more points, or broke the association's records. Therefore, Laker's performence was not well at all. But now he is not what he was, he is no longer selfish. Instead he is very selfless. He helps his teammates to perform better, and helps his team to defeat their rivals. Now Laker is the hot candidate of NBA championship. From Kobe's change, I learn one thing. I learn if you want your team to defeat others, you should selfless. And it is also the most important way that we get along with other people in daily life, isn't it?

subject: IW-0802
content: In my heart, my super idol is my mom. She is a wonderful woman and always works very hard. Although she is busy all day long, she never say no to give us a hand. At night, she never stop working because she has a lot of houseworks to do. In our house, my mom is a superwoman and nothing can't do. I will never forgot what my mom had told me. She said "In my life, you and your brother are all of my life. Without you, I'm nothing and no meaning." Because of those words I know that my mom is brave. She can give up everything with her lover but she will never give up her lover. All of those reason let me feel that my mom is my idol and never change. I will follow her steps until I can't do.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is a famous Japanese group --- w-inds. The group is consist of three young boys, they are talented in not only singing but also dancing. The main singer in this group is called "Keita", he is selected in hundreds of applicants, it's why their ablums sell like a hot cake. The reason I like them is very simple, I admire the beautiful voice and always feel very relax when I listen their CD. Their dance is full of energy. The member named "Ryohei" danced the best. He often catches my eyes while I watching their MVs. I will forever support my favorite idol, and I think they can bring more happiness to others just as they gave me.

subject: IW-0802
content: In this world, there are many people who play an important role in my mind. My father has a lot of influence on me. He is my idol. For example, I remembered one day evening. A car accident happened in the road, and there isn't any people nearby. When my father drived me to the airport, we met the victims in a bad weather and in a big trouble. Although we were in a rush, my father insisted on helping him. He called to the police for their help, did the CPR for them and kept talking with them until the police reached there. But we were late for the airplane. So our family didn't go to America. But the victims thank for my father very much. I'm prond of my father. When the thing happened, my father becomes my idol and I always learn to him.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have idols who are liked by them. Such as TV celebrities, athletes, or writers, and I'm no exception. I like many idols such as Jay, Jolin, Wang Lee hom and so on. Among these I like Jolin best. Because she is beautiful and she can not only sings songs but also dance well. When watching Jolin's performes, I can't help shutting. And I also admire her humility. From past to now, even if she has been very famous, she still shows humble.

subject: IW-0802
content: There are many idols on the TV. I admit I also have liked some idols. And there are some advantages on this thing. Before, I'd like to watch idols like James and some basketball stars. At that time, I always watched TV because I'd like to look how these ball could be shoot so beautiful. So I waste lots of time to watch it. And my homeworks always not finished and my grades got lower and lower. With my ages get older and older. I always watch it not at the same side. For example, I'd like to know how he could be so great. I realized someone couldn't be a surper-star so easily. It would have some resons. Like James, he always played basketball alone until midnight. So he should get this success. Not at sports, everything is the same. You just working hard, then someone help you get success. After senior high school, I just do my best on studying and I feel grades get higher and higher. I thought some super-stars can make you get the goal easily. After entering college, I will chose some idols who can help me the most.

subject: IW-0802
content: Not only teenagers have their idol but adults have someone they admired. I thought my idol is more factually than others, my father. Like other people's father, my father also hit us when I did wrong things. My classmates' parents always let then went everywhere, but my father didn't. Although I don't like he limit us, I could know he really love us. In the pass time, I very like the detective, Formasa. To our amazement, he could solve the problems by special ways. Now, I have known that there is a man who is more perfect than he, my father. Maybe he is not like the police who catch the thefts. Perhaps he doesn't write books to say how he solve the difficult questions. I just know that he always helps other people. My father likes to save mony in order to give the poors. He also hopes us could do more things for the people who needs help. To thanks him, the best thing I should do is pass the English test.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has their own idols, and so do I. I think my idol must be kind and delligent. The idol I used to like such as Jay or Jolin. They are handsome and beautiful. And they sing songs well. I also learned to sing their songs well, but I failed. I was the fans of them. I was carzy about their CDs and posters. And I bought a lot of this things. I almost went to every concert which were held by them. But, I prefer Chen-Min Wang nowadays. I think he is the best baseball player from Taiwan. He pitches baseball very well. And he usually wins the games. So I think that he is my new idol undoubtfully. Because of he, I go to play baseball in baseball studium almost every weekend. And I often turn on TV at the midde of night in order to watch him pitch baseball and cheer for him. Having an idol is really great. He or she gives us an aim to pursue.
