subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their favorite idols and I am in no exception. The idol may be an actor, a politician or an athlete, but my idol is my father. My father is not only a good husband but a wonderful father. As a husband, he remembers all the special days including the Valentine's day and my mother's birthday. He is so romantic that he never forgets to prepare a big meal to celebrate their special days. He is considerate and takes good care of my mother's need. As a father, he is perfect beyond discription. He wakes me up every morning and cooks delicious breakfast. He never loses his temper when I do the wrong things, but teaches me again and again with patience. He respects every decision I make and always supports me when I face the difficulties. With his love and care, I feel that I am the most lucky girl in the world.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is Carolyn who is my best friend. She has a beautiful face, long hair and long legs.Many boys want to be her boyfriend. Although she comes from a single-parent family, she still works hard. She always tries to do well on everything in order not to let her mom or teacher worry too much about her. So she is usually complimented by her mom or teacher, but she is still modest. She told me that she wants to be a vet someday. She said that she likes animals whether it is domestic animal or wild animal. And she wants to help the dogs or cats who don't have lovely home. This girl has a right direction which keeps her going down. I want to be a girl like her.

subject: IW-0802
content: That's true. Everyone has his own idol. It could be everybody such as TV star, baseball player, the president or his parents. As for me, the president  is my idol now. The reason is quite obvious. Probably everyone knows that. Firstly the president  is the honestest person I have ever seen. and He is geneous and kindness to everyone. Secondly he is a tall and handsome man, so the women love him and the men admire him. What a lucky guy he is. Thirdly and also the most important one is that he got the ability to make our country better in the near future. So president  is not only idol, but also everyone's idol in Taiwan.

subject: IW-0802
content: I think many people have their idols and so do I. My favorite idol is Jolin because She is not only good at dancing but also singing songs. She is so hard that she can be my perfect idol in my heart. I very like her dressings because they are so fashion, them I can learn. Dancing is my favorite job and I want to be a dancer in the future. So I can learn her skills. I like Jolin very much and I'm her big fan. If I could meet her someday, I would tell her that you are my super idol. I hope she can do her best on her stage.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my father. He is a doctor and he knows a lot of things. He is the best man I have ever seen. He is a doctor who help lots of people. In the world, there are many terrible accident and need to send people to the hospital. When people were sent to the hospital, my father must go to see what he can help. Some people have hurt to terrible that they are going to die, but my father won't give up. He will try to save their lives from end to end. He also knows lots of things. Being a high school student, I always have a lot of problems on studies. When I have problem, I will ask my father to help me find the answer. He always answers me with the best answer and tell my why. When he has free time, he often teaches me the science, math, english, chinese, and even history. All to all, he is the best man that I am so happy that I am his son. I want to study hard to become my idol in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is the great general, Nepoleon. Although he was said to be short, he led the Frech to overcome the difficulties they faced. He almost conquered all countries in Europe as well. Now, he is still viewed as a hero by French. I am also not tall, but I am ambitious. I expect myself to be as good as Nepoleon. He was not only good at winning a war, but also good at politics. I will make my effort to improve my leading abilitiy. Although it seems impossible for me right now, I will do my best. As the saying goes, "Where there is a will, there is a way."

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my father. He is stern with everyone, especially we three children. Though he doesn't have a handsome appearance, we respect him wholeheart. My father has a poor income; however, he works so hard that he can support our family. Sometimes he got hurt out of carelessness, I was worried about him. Even if he has an additional salary, he won't spend money satisfying himself for entertainment. He is stern with us, because he wants everyone of us can be a well-behaved person in the society, and can make contributions to the world. I want to earn a big fortune in the near future, for I hope that I can make him lead a happy life. He is the idol that I adore and respect most!

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their favorite idols like celebrities, atheles and writers. Take myself for example. Jolin is my favorite idol. The main reasons can be written as follows: First of all, she can dance very well and beautifully. I wish I could dance so well as she. Therefore, she also can speak English well. I want to be a person who can speak good English like her. The most importantly, she always works very hard. No matter how tired she is, she always tries he best to do all her tasks perfectly. And this is the most important attitude I have to learn. I think she is the most successful singer in the world. These are the reasons why I like her.

subject: IW-0802
content: Every people must have their own idol, and so am I. I like to see Disney's movies, like high school muscial 1. 2. So I like Vanessa and Zac very much. Vanessa is very beautiful and very good at singing and acting. Zac is very very handsome and he has an blue eyes and good at acting. I like to see some foreign movies, because I think that is better that Taiwan's movie. It has more interested for me. So someday I saw high school muscial on TV. At the end of the movie, it made me felt happy and really want to seen it again. Many people in my class had seen it before, and they feel very good, too. So I suggest if you want to see a movie, see the High School muscial, you wouldn't want to miss it.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has an idol in his mind, including me. As for my idol, she's a singer. With beautiful voice and a charming face, there's no doubt to like her. Her name is Penny, a talented singer who always produces impressing songs. Few years ago when I turned on the radio, her voice came into my ears. It was too beautiful for me to stop listening to it. Later, I found that the song was sang by Penny. I bought her CD immediately and couldn't wait to hear the voice again. Until now, I still like her music a lot. She produces her songs all by herself, how talented she is! Except her voice and pretty face, that's another reason why I like her so much.I think I'll never forget the chords Penny sings!

subject: IW-0802
content: Everybady has his or her own idol. Some people like the actor or actress on the movie, and the other like the people who has great event. My idol isn't an actor or an author; my mother, she is the person whom I most respect in the world. Because of some reasons, she didn't go to school when she was a child. After she grow up, she had to cook for whole family, and washed their clothes. But she never complained. She got married on 20 years old. Unforthually, my father passed away when I was twelve years old. I have one young brother and one younger sister and she had to rise us by herself. She always teach us not to complain, and everyone has it's own life. She always smiles while she face the trouble. I am so admire her, and she is the best idol for me.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has his or her favorite idol. You like them because they do something that you are interested in or make you feel pleased. I loved the players of National Basketball Association before, but now my idol is my father. When he was a child, he wasn't good at studying and liked to fool around. The time pasted so fast, now he has his own career and was a boss. He always says "The more you paid, the more you got!". Though he wasted a lot of time in his young age, he worked hard after he finished his high school. I love him because he never gives up. In addition, there is nothing impossible in his mind.

subject: IW-0802
content: There are a lot of people are crazy about there idols, such as base ball players, singers, movie stars and even politics. I also have a idol now, he is Eiichiro Oda, the author of the famous comic series named "ONE PIECE". He is a Japanese comic author. His birthday is on January 1st and it is also the birthday of one of a character of his comics. When he was a student, he liked to draw a lot of comics. He also has lots of imagination. That is why "ONE PIECE", one of his comics, is very popular all over the world. I like him very much because of his characterization. He is just like "Monkey D. Luffy", the main character of "ONE PIECE". He likes to relax the time when he draws his comics. He also makes a lot of effort in his own comics. That makes him make a lot of friends, such as his co-worker and his fans. I have known "ONE PIECE" for three years. It is full of adventures and characters which are very lovely. Over one hundred million copies are sold only in eight years. That is because of his great imagination. For me, he is the best comic author in the world.

subject: IW-0802
content: Who is my idol? It goes without saying that the person is my uncle Mike. My uncle, Mike, is fourty years old now, but he looks just like he is only twenty-five years old. And he was lived in America, he usually went to Taiwan to visit us on summer vacation every years. He is also an excellent administrator of his own company. He is really a good man. The reason why my idol is my uncle was because he is so funny, and I thought he is really a optimism person. When I was a junior high school student, I really didn't feel happy and always cried for not any reason. But, in a time, my uncle took me to a hospital, he wanted me to look the patients who had to stay in the hospital, and to think about myself. All of a sudden, I knew what he wanted me to understand. Now, I am a girl as optimism as my uncle, and I still often learn lots of lessons from him.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol My idol is a group. A famous group in Japan. They are very popular because they sing and dance well. The group is W-inds, which is composed of three boys. Why do I like them a lot? That is because they look upon their work and do their best to give their fans the best show. They are well-known but they don't boast themselves. They always make their progress gradually to give their fans a show which is the best show they've ever seen. Most important of all, they don't make bad idols for the society. That's why I love them very much and why they are so popular in the eastern Asia.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is the band which named "Sodagreen." People alway say the name is so special and try to learn them deeply. "Green" means natural, and they would like to make people relax especially in a busy life; "Soda" means fresh, they want to let us know how beautiful our life is. It is everywhere that new things appear. What a good explanation, isn't it? The band consists of five peoples, four men and one woman. The local voice is so umbelivable. Owing to his special voice, the band is paid most attention than they had ever been. There is almost one thing special in the band. It is that there is a person to play the viola. What is viola? It is little bigger than the violin, and its sound is lower than the violin's. It can catch our attention to their amazing music. By the way, they are the first independent band that performed in the Taiwan Big Egg. Their fourth album "Unmatchable beauty" is very popular and famous. They are more and more serious to their music and we can listen better and better music that they make. Their good is all the more for my introducing.

subject: IW-0802
content: Lots of people have their own idol. It can be popular singer, active baseball players or some writers. I have my own idol as well, though he isn't a household name. He is my junior high school teacher. Being different from other teachers, he didn't take good grades as the most essential thing. Instead, he spent much time on teaching us how to behave well. When I did badly on my test, he encouraged me. But when I did wrong in my school life, he punished me. With his teaching, I can be the leader of a club in senior high now. I can know how to lead others and what a leader should be. For me, he is so excellent that I can't reach. I hope I can learn more from him. He is not only my teacher but also my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my mother. I think she is the best in the world. She always full of power, and wears smile. She is very kind and friendly, and likes to help other who need help. Although she is not rich, she always do her best to help others. I love my mom because she is the best mom in the world. She works hard everyday but she never ingores me and my brother, she very care about us. Many people said my mom is a superwomen, because she can do many things. But I do not like my mom to do many works. My mom is also good at cooking. I like eat everything what she cooks. After I finishing my high school, I have to move to another city. I think I will miss my mom and what she do for me.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is neither singer nor sporter. My mom is the super woman in my heart. I love her for everything. First, she always smiles that let me feel happy. Second, she do every housework by herselt and never feel tired. Thrid, she is not only cooking well but also singing good. My mom teaches me many things. For instand, when I was five years old, she teached me how to ride bicycle. When I was ten, she took me to go camping with my family. She let me know how to be an independent person. Now, I am a senior high student, I still love my mom. She will be my super idol ever and forever, and I want to be next one.

subject: IW-0802
content: There is no denying that everyone has his favorite idol on the world. And I am not exception. My idol is my mother. I think she must be the greatest mother all over the world. My mother who is a housewife does housework all day long. However, she never says she is tired. Instead, she does her best to make our life comfortable. I can't thank her enough. Finally, I want to pluck up my courage to say something to her, "Mommy, I would love you forever more."

subject: IW-0802
content: Coco, a popular singer, is my faverite idol. Since ten years ago when I was an elementary school student, I have heard her name and her beautiful voice. She is good at singing different kinds of music and dancing very natually. Her songs are sometimes graceful and sometimes exciting. Dancing, to her, is just like a piece of cake. Seeing her dancing on TV, I always shakes my body with her and songs. That's why I love her so much. As a fan, I went to her every concerts. Every elbums she released are now in my room. I am so crazy about her. I swear to myself that I will follow her steps and become popular as her in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content: Most people have idols. For example, singers, actors, artists, and so on. But my idol is very special, she is a person from cartoon, named "Sola." I like her because of her nice personality. She is cute and active. This cartoon is about the stage. She is the main actor in this film. At the early age, she determined to persue a dream being a wonderful actor on the stage, and to perform the best skills. She came over all the difficulties. Just like her, when I was young, I also wanted to be a actor. I seldom tell the truth to others because they think it's impossible. So I hid the secret in mind. Long time after, I'm a senior high school student now. But I have not changed my dream. I believe if this is what I really want, it won't change by time. I set a goal to be a performer with nice attitude like my idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: Generally, most people choose movie stars or pop music stars as their idol. But for me, when being asked such a question, I will always answered it is Frida that appeals me the most. Frida is a maxican artist that paints great arts but lives a hard life. She was seriously injured in an car accident when she was a teenager. Everyone, including her mother and several doctors, did believe that she can never walk again. However, not only did Frida walk again but became a great artist. Despite all the disease and pain, she keeps painting those things she wants to preach about in her life. Her paiting which was written a word "Viva la vida" did encourage me in the gloomy time during my life. I always tell myself to think of Frida, keeping my own idiosyncracy and the pain will soon fades!

subject: IW-0802
content: When it comes to my favorite idol, it must be Michael Jordan, a black man, who is popular with all around the world. To begin with, the first reason that I appreciate him is his will. When he was a senior high school student, he practiced playing basketball six hours a day. Why he played so hard? Because he wanted to realize his dream which was to be a successful basketball player. Soon, Jordan joined the NBA and won the MVP. He did become a famous and successful basketball player. However, he was not proud of this, but to keep the former attitude. That is the second reason I love him. He reminds me of an old saying, "Where there is a will, there is a way."

subject: IW-0802
content: There are many idols around the world. But I only like one person. who is Korean. His name is Jun-ki Lee. Why I like him? Is he handsame? I don't think do. I liked his looks that look like a girl. (By the way, I am go straight.) And he has many great performance, including movie, sing and TV. I am impressed with his performed skills in two television program which called "My girl" and "Dog and Wolf." First time I saw him in the program "My girl," I thought he is a "girl." When my mother told me that he is a boy, I was very surprised at that time. I liked him since then. I think I like him just because he is my favorite stylish star. Most important thing is that he doesn't like other super star liked to pretend. He is so true that I like him so much.

subject: IW-0802
content: Many people have their favorite idols, for example, some good-looking stars, famous athletes or popular writers. I also have one, and she is my mother! Other people may be confused that my idol is my mom. But I have my reason. I think she is a most special woman in the world. She is a charming and patient mother. She always helps me out when I am in trouble. And when I was wrong, she didn't punish me, instead of encouraging me. I have millions reasons for looking she as a marvelous mother. In my thought, she is a super idol for me forever and ever. Do you also have a unique idol of your own?

subject: IW-0802
content: My Favorite Idol My favorite idol is my brother who studies in NCKU. My brother is not only smart but also beneviolent. The reason why my idol is my brother is that he always helps me when I have problem. I am not good at math so he usually teaches me how to solve these questions. When the monthly exam is coming, my brother also studies with me. Though math is still the biggest enemy for me, I think that I can overcome it with my brother's help. Studying in NCKU was his dream so he always studied hard. When his dream finally came true, all of my family members were very happy and proud of him. I really felt happy for my brother. Now, I will do my best to do every thing and study hard. I believe that someday I will also become as smart as my brother. The most important thing is that I won't give up and I will keep going.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is a singer and an actor. He is Andy Liu. I have liked Andy since I was an elementary school student. Whenever he releases a new album, I will buy it. Surely, I also go to see his movies. Some of my friends like him, too. He is very popular with many people. In my view, he is a hard-working and diligent person. He constantly changes himself because he wants to be a well-known and a successful movie star and singer. Although he makes a lot of money, he still donates some money to the poor and the charity. That is why I admire him very much. When he got trouble in many ways, he never escapes. He always tells himself and fans not to give up. We should try our best to overcome difficulities. According to what I mentioned above, I learned many good thoughts from him. Because he always teaches his fans correct concepts, he hopes that his fans can do many good things, for example, helping the people who need help. He sets a good example in society.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has their own idol, and I am no exception. I am a big NBA fan. I enjoy watching NBA games every weekend. My favorite NBA star is Michael Jordan. Michael Jordan is famous around the world. All the basketball fans are very very crazy for him because of his talent on basketball. Michael Jordan did amazing skills in the game. He scored easily and helped his team became the best NBA team in the US. I think no one can beat Jordan in the gym. Michael Jordan has been my idol for many years. I appriciate him not only because of his basketball skill but also about his sport spirit and hard working. Jordan made at least 3000 shoots every day. He was also the first one to the gym but the last one to leave. He never feel tired, Jordan always inspired his teamates and told them not to give up. I think this is the reason why that every one likes him and respect him.

subject: IW-0802
content: It was quiet a long time when I was only ten years old. Britney Spears, a pretty young American singer became an idol of mine. I'm amazed by the way how she sing a song, her voice was so different from other singers that whenever you heard the voice you would know it was hers with no doubt. However, when times went by, people would change, and Britney changed, too. In my mind, Britney had always been a very pure girl that I thought she wouldn't turn into some other singers who shows bad behaviors and not accepted by us. I'm so disappointed by her, and this idol died in my heart when I was sixteen. Because of the bad appearance she made, I never had been crazy about anyone anymore. Till now I'm not very passionate with anything about the celebraties on TV. Thus, it didn't mean that I won't have a new idol in me. And this special person is someone I loved and respected in my whole life, that is my father. I would never forget how he had took care of me and the spirit of working hard he had.

subject: IW-0802
content: Jolin is the idol who I really admired a lot. To be honest, I have to admit that I didn't like her the first time I saw her on the TV. So I didn't notice her at first. After about two years, I noticed her because of her problem of law. It really made a bad impression on me. More two years, I've noticed her again. She changed a lot and her dance and singing really attacted me. Therefore, I started to look for imformations about her. I found that she really worked hard. Nowaday, most of the young student are crazy for her. Despite that she had been awful, she just alway wants to do her best and show her best. The spirit is good enough for me to see her as a idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite super idol is Jolin. There are some reasons for it. First, she can sing well. I love to enjoy her songs anytime. And I learn to sing her songs, too. Second, she is beautiful. She has big eyes. And her hair style is always different. Third, she also dance well. She practices day and night. So she always performs wonderfully. Above all, Jolin is such a perfect girl that no wonder every fans love her. That's why I consider Jolin as my super idol.

subject: IW-0802
content: Every one has an idol in their heart. Of course including me. My idol is a senior high school student whose name is Julia. She is not smart but very enthusiastic. She likes to help the other people. Once time, when we went climbing the mountains, I was suddenly fallen up, and my knee was bleeding. Every one was frightened by the situation. They just stood up there and didn't know how to do, excepting one person who was Julia. She picked some tessues to stop my bleeding-knee and hung me to home. It sounds nothing special at all, right? But actually, she is shorter and thinner than me. I am really thankful for her. Although she doesn't have a good grade, but I can certaintly say that she has a sweet heart. The girl who likes to help the others. The girl who doesn't mind to give others more than herself. The girl whose name is Julia is definitely an idol in my heart. Thank you so much, my Julia.

subject: IW-0802
content: My idol is my English teacher. I was taught by her for six years. She is a hardworking woman who has a great passion on her own work. She spend lots of time on all of her students. She travel all over the world, but she likes Taiwan the most. Every time in the class, she tell us what happened in her trip. The most important reason about why I esteem her my idol is that she is different from others. Though she teaches English, she likes Chinese the most. She hope us spend more time on studying Chinese instead of English because we are Chinese. We have a much more interesting history than other countries.

subject: IW-0802
content: Most of my friends like Jolin, and so do I. She is a beautiful singer. She doesn't attrack me only by her beauty, but her voice and performances. I like her songs and dance so much. There's a proverb says "Practice makes perfect." She always sings and dances well on her concert. It means she must be dilligent. I likes to dance. Therefore, I join the dance club in my school. We have to practice dancing everyday so that we can perform well on the exhibition. I hope I can dance as well as she does in the future.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol has been my older brother. With a fascinating appearance, he is smart and strong as well. He's such an excellent guy. First, he always gets good grades in every subject and works hard for any assignment given by teachers. Second, he plays basketball well. You won't find an opponent good enough to win him. Most of all, he is by no means pround and teachs others patiently. So his relationship is good as well. All people around him are pround of him, inclusive of me. That's why I appreciate him very much. I'm really lucky to have this wonderful brother, also my good teacher, along me. I hope I can learn many useful and meaningful things from him.

subject: IW-0802
content: Almost everyone has an idle in mind, including the celebrateds or the friends around our life. For me, Chery, one of my best friends, is an idle to learning to. Kind of Chery, she is always with smile on face to everybody she meet, seldom angry, humor and considerate. Besides the great personality, Chery is also brillian and good at every subjects, including the P.E. lesson and swimming, which are problems to many girls. Independed Chery hasn't been afriend of every challenges in her life. Sometime we get together to finish a work, she almost everytime can think of good idea to solve the problem we meet. Without Chery, I couldn't image how boring the day would been. And now, I will take Chery to be not only the idle but also the modle to learn to.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is my best friend. I think he's good at everything, such as exercising, playing musical instruments, socializing ... etc. His name is John, whose parents are teachers, so I always think that's why he always looks like a gentleman. Moreover, as our teacher says that he's an extremely outstanding student due to his performance, he just smiles all the time. And if I have and problems, he would come and teach me how to solve, even though he almost has no time. Actually, he's so popular in our school that numerous girls like him. Besides, hardly is he able to be punished. That's why he can be my favorite idol. At last, I think he's perfect.

subject: IW-0802
content: I now worship J.K. Rowling as an idol. She wrote the seven novels of Harry Potter. It took her a lot of time to write each novel because she was out of job and had to take care of her baby daughter alone. The reason I like is because she accept her life and try to change it. Even though she didn't know if she will be successful or not, she still believed in herself and kept on writing. She finally succeed and made a lot of money and became one of the richest women in the world. I hope that I can be like her and I won't be afraid of failing. Also, I hope that I can believe in myself and become a successful person.

subject: IW-0802
content: My favorite idol is a singer whose name is Jay. As far as I know, Jay is not only a good singer but also a marvelous composer. Above all, he graduated from a musician university. So it is not strange to say why he can compose excellent music. He says "As leaves are to trees, so music is to me." This is the most important reason why I like him. Undoubtedly, he takes it for his goal which is becoming a professional composer. For this reason, I will make up my mind too. I will study hard and go to a good university. The last but not least, god helps those who help themselves.

subject: IW-0802
content: Everyone has an idol, and so do I. I enjoy watching baseball, as you can see, my idol would surely be the most well-known player in Taiwan --- Cheng-Ming Wong. Every great player all had his or her own story. For Wong, not giving up is his belief. Before being so famous, Wong was a normal person just like you and me, but the thing that makes him so different from us is a heart with great love for baseball. Becides that, Wong not only just played baseball but also took his father's advice --- keep studying for the college. Because of his nice pitch during the college game, the Yankee soon noticed him, asking him to join them. Though Wong is now a very famous person in Taiwan, he's still quite diligent --- that's why I like him so much!

subject: IW-0802
content: When people asked me who my idol is, I always said the star whose name is Jolin. Jolin is the top star in Taiwan, even in Asia. She is the best singer, almost her albums was collected by me. Also, she is the best dancer. She had learned many kind of dance from different countries. From many people's view points, Jolin is only can do these, but from mine, Jolin is a good actress, too. She had acted in her music video many times. And I often touched by those music video. If someone ask me "Why are you love Jolin very much?" I will tell him or her that "Jolin is best in many ways, but when she started to be a singer, she was not as popular as now. She likes a swan, growing from ugly. Now, she is the top idol, because of her hard-working. This is the best idea for many teenagers to learn." So, Jolin is the best in my eyes, no matter how will tomorrow become, I will support her forever. She is the best star all over the world!

subject: IW-0802
content: I'm crazy about Krean idols which called TVXQ. And the translation of Japanese is tohoshinki. They have five members. Their own fans are called cassiopeia. I'm very glad to be the one of their fans. I love them because they always have different kinds of songs. They try their best to present us the best work. "Never give up!" is their spirite. They have great passion so I can be inspired by their music. They are the most radiant stars in Asia and our mind.

subject: IW-0802
content: I remember when I was seven years old, my father is my best friend, best toy and even is my best idol. The reason that he could be my best idol is because, he is tall and he is good at everything, for example: he could play the baseball as well as the player on the stage, he could play piano as well as Morzart play, and he also could speak English as well as a Americans" in my hart he is just like my super man, my super idol. Joining in a school club is a good way to train our teamwork and the ability of organization. No matter what club you are in, you can get the different and memorable experience. Because you can get along with the schoolmates from every class, and you can learn how to organize club events. But students nowadays have a lot of studies, "time" is important to them. So making time to join in a school club must be a difficult thing to them.
As a student, I joined in "love-giving club". That's my favorite, because I like helping people. We always went to the orphan homes and retirement homes to help the orphans and the elders. It was a special experience for me. Today, I still remember many touching things of the school club. It also reminds me that how rich I am, and I should cherish everything I own.

subject: IW-1001
content:
Many people think that school club is a very important ingredient in their school life, and so do I. To make my memories be colorful, join a cool school club is one of the best choices! There are many different kinds of school clubs in my school, such as swimming club, comic club, guitar club, and so on. As far as I'm concerned, each club has one thing in common -- to learn some special skills. Take magic club for example, you can learn it and show it to the girl you like. It seemed that it's a good way to attract other people! But the disadvantage is that some students are so crazy about their school club that they even ignored their exam and homework.
Joining a foreign language club appeals to me very much. I can learn another languages like French or Japanese which can help me to make friends throughout the world. Moreover, I can get some imformations about foreign cultures! It not only expand my horizons but also give me more knowledge than other students.
Even though school club is interesting, trying to join it as wisely as we can and control the time we spend are seriously for us.

subject: IW-1001
content:
In Taiwan, over ninty percent of junior and senior high school students once join school clubs. Let's talk about the merits and demerits of joining school clubs.
I think that there are three merits of joining school clubs. One is that we can learn new things, such as playing the guitar, dancing locking, gusturing hand language, and so on. Another merit is that we can make friends. There are many students in the same clubs, so we can make friends with them. And the last merit is that we can make good use of time. In addition to studying, we should also practice what we learn in the school club. To do all the things, we need to make good use of our time.
And I think that the demerit is that we may spend too much time in the school clubs and forget to study. It leads us to get bad scores.
The school club that I am very interesting in is popular dance club. Because I like dancing very much. If I join that school club, I can learn some ways to dance, such as poping and locking. So I am interesting in joining that school club.

subject: IW-1001
content:
Join a school club is a good thing. Though some people may thought that if I wast time join a club, I don't have time to do my homework or prepare the test. I think not. Join a culb can open our view. It can also knows the people who is also intreasting in this thing. And I can also learn some things that school never teaches you!

In the club, I felt my weight was loss, I could do exercise every day. Not only learned the martial art, but learned how to prepare the activity. I though if I didn't join the club, I would miss very things: the martial art and the people.

content:

For instance, we can make friends in club, and we learn how to get along with peers. We also understand the issue the club discusses about and get a large amount of information from activities. On the other hand, we have to spend much time on those. To high school students, it may be a waste of time. When it takes us too much time, we don't have enough time to study, the most important thing in this period.
Hence, my favorit club is chores because we can sing anytime, anywhere. We have to practice singing; however, it is very happy and it won't take too much time, so that I can study. In addition, we must walk on the stage and perform. As audience give us a big hand, we have the sense of victory. Thus, it is the reason that I am interested in it most.

content:

On the negative side, some students may spend too much time on their school clubs, and they can't concentrate on the school work. By doing so, they also can't do well on their test.
Now, I am also a student, and I think the singing club in our school is very interesting. Without saying, I really have a good time singing with others. In addition, our teacher also teaches us lots of singing skills. And I really improve a lot.
In conclusion, I think going to a school club is certainly a good way to reduce our stress. Just remember that school work is still very important. At last, I hope everyone can enjoy their school club very much.

content:

Join the school club is a great thing, but don't let your studies get safer, because study is our very own job as long as you're still a student!

content:

subject: IW-1001
content: School club is a part of education at Junior high schools and senior high schools today. While many school clubs were formed, some of them may be educational, and some of them are just for entertainment. However, they all have some benefits to the students. Students may learn new things other than what they learned at school, and they can also have fun and find their interests while joining different kinds of clubs. Also, joining the school clubs can let the students take a rest from schoolwork and the stressed school life. However, some of the students won't be concentrating on their schoolwork when they join school clubs. There may be too many school clubs and the students don't have time to squeeze them in. Besides these things, school clubs are still good for junior high school and senior high school students. That is why I love to join all kinds of clubs, andbfall the clubs, I love the movie club most. I didn't have time to watch the movie I like at the theater, so this could be the chance for me. Also, the school has picked out some educational movies for junior high school students like us, so we can also learn from the movies. School clubs are entertainments for students in high schools, and we can not only have fun but learn a lot of things there, too.
